blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Foundation models pretrained on large natural-image collections are increasingly adapted for medical image segmentation, in the expectation that they will replace models trained for each task. Most comparisons, however, use data from the training distribution and a single task-specific baseline whose configuration is rarely justified, and therefore provide limited evidence of performance at new clinical sites. It also remains unclear how much of a foundation model must be adapted, and what determines this. We adapted a foundation model, DINOv2, with strategies ranging from tuning only its bias terms to full fine-tuning, and compared it with U-Nets and ResU-Nets trained from scratch. Experiments covered colonoscopy, breast ultrasound and dermoscopy, with testing on held-out data from the training source and on independent datasets from other institutions. The adapted foundation model generalised better on every external dataset. Within the training distribution, the task-specific models remained competitive when training data were abundant, and delineated boundaries more precisely, while the foundation model more often missed small lesions. Only a small fraction of the foundation model required adaptation, and the capacity needed was determined by the imaging domain rather than by the adaptation method. A widely used polyp test set was also found to duplicate images from another benchmark. Foundation-model adaptation is therefore warranted where models must work across sites, with capacity selected on the target domain.
blocks.zh: 在大型自然图像收集上预先培训的基础模型越来越多地适应医疗图像的分解,期望它们能取代为每项任务培训的模型。 但是,大多数比较使用来自培训分配的数据和单一任务特定基准,其配置很少合理,因此在新的临床地点提供的业绩证据有限。 还不清楚必须调整多少基础模式,以及决定这一点的是什么。 我们改编了一个基础模型,DINov2, 其战略从只调整其偏差条款到全面微调, 实验包括结肠镜检查、乳房超声波和皮肤镜检查,并测试来自培训来源的搁置数据以及来自其他机构的独立数据集。 调整后的基础模型在每一个外部数据集上都得到了更好的概括。 在培训分配中,在培训数据充足、划定界限更为精确时,具体任务模式仍然具有竞争力,而基础模式往往忽略了小的损伤。 基础模型只有一小部分需要适应,所需能力由成像领域而不是由适应方法决定。 还发现一个被广泛使用的多p测试集可以重复另一个基准的图像. 因此,在模型必须横跨不同地点发挥作用、在目标领域选定能力的情况下,有必要进行基础模型改造。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision foundation models, pretrained on hundreds of millions of images at a scale no clinical dataset approaches, have made a question urgent for medical image segmentation. Given a new dataset and task, is it better to adapt one of these models, or to train a task-specific architecture from random initialisation as the field has done since U-Net?
blocks.zh: 视界基础模型在规模上对数亿的图像进行预先训练,没有临床数据集方法,这使医学图像分解问题变得迫切. 鉴于新的数据集和任务,是否最好调整其中一种模型,还是像自U-Net以来的实地工作那样,从随机初始化中培训特定任务架构?

blocks.en: The question matters because of where segmentation models are deployed. A model trained at one hospital is intended for use at others, on images from different scanners, protocols and patient populations. This distribution shift, rather than in-domain accuracy, is the principal obstacle to clinical adoption, and it is invisible in the measurement usually reported. Every model in this study is therefore evaluated under two regimes: in domain, on held-out data from the training distribution, and out of distribution, on data from institutions that contributed nothing to training.
blocks.zh: 这个问题之所以重要,是因为分解模型是在哪里部署的。 在一个医院培训的一个模型打算用于其他医院,用于不同扫描仪、规程和病人的图像。 这种分布变化,而不是域内准确性,是临床采纳的主要障碍,在通常报告的测量中是看不见的. 因此,本研究的每个模式都通过两种制度加以评价:域内、培训分发的搁置数据以及未分发的、对培训毫无贡献的机构的数据。

blocks.en: The literature comparing the two approaches generally reports that adapted foundation models win, and three properties of how that comparison is made limit what follows from it. It is usually conducted within the training distribution, so a property of the evaluation is reported as a property of the models. It is usually made against a single task-specific model whose configuration is not itself defended, and Isensee et al. [31] show that many claimed improvements over U-Net are made against a weakly configured instance of it; the two objections compound, since an advantage so obtained can be an artefact of both at once. It is also usually made at a single operating point, that is, at one choice of settings such as the adaptation rank or the training budget, so a statement about one configuration appears to be a statement about the methods.
blocks.zh: 比较这两种方法的文献一般都报告说,经过调整的基础模型获胜,而这种比较方法的三个特性限制了从中得出的结果。 通常在培训分配范围内进行,因此评价的属性作为模型属性报告. 它通常以一个单一的任务特定模式来制作,而这个模式的配置本身并没有被捍卫,而Isensee等人. [31] 表明,许多声称比U-Net改进之处是针对一个配置薄弱的例子作出的;两种反对意见合在一起,因为这样获得的优势可能同时是两者的异物。 它也通常在一个单一的操作点进行,即选择一个环境,如适应等级或培训预算,所以关于一个配置的说明似乎是关于方法的说明.

blocks.en: A parallel gap concerns how much adaptation a target requires. Dutt et al. [17] , in classification and generation tasks, report that parameter-efficient methods are most effective in low-data regimes, making training-set size the governing quantity and one known before any experiment; Teuber et al. [58] report the contrary directly, finding no such advantage even at very small training sizes, and attribute the variation to properties of the dataset, which are not known in advance. What neither establishes is whether the requirement belongs to the domain or to the method supplying the adaptation.
blocks.zh: 一个平行的差距涉及一个目标需要多少适应。 Dutt 等 (英语). [17] 在分类和生成任务中,报告参数效率高的方法在低数据制度中最为有效,使培训设置的大小成为管理数量,并且在任何试验前都知道的数量;Teuber等人。 [58] 直接报告相反的情况,发现即使在训练规模很小的情况下也没有这种优势,并将这种变化归因于数据集的特性,这些特性是事先不知道的。 既不确定要求是属于域还是属于提供适应的方法。

blocks.en: The aim of this study is to determine, for medical image segmentation, when adaptation of a pretrained foundation model is warranted in place of a task-specific architecture, and what governs the amount of adaptation such a model requires. It does so along two axes. The architecture axis compares an adapted foundation model with task-specific architectures trained from random initialisation; the adaptation axis varies how much of the foundation model is adapted, measuring how the choice of adaptation strategy affects cross-dataset generalisation and whether the capacity required is a property of the domain or of the method supplying it.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的目的是,为了医疗图像的分解,确定何时需要修改预先训练的基础模型,以取代特定任务的结构,并确定这种模型需要多少适应。 它沿着两条轴线这样做。 架构轴将调整后的基础模型与从随机初始化中训练出来的特定任务架构进行比较;适应轴则不同多少基础模型被调整,衡量适应策略的选择如何影响跨数据集的泛化,所需能力是域属性还是提供域的方法属性.

blocks.en: Both axes span three imaging domains—colonoscopy polyp imaging, breast ultrasound and skin lesion dermoscopy—each with one training source and held-out test sets, giving eight out-of-distribution test sets, one of which (CVC-T) consists of images also present in another (CVC-ColonDB; Section 3.2 ). The foundation model is a DINOv2-Small encoder with a minimal linear decoder, adapted under strategies spanning 385 to 22.1 million trainable parameters. The task-specific comparators are a plain U-Net and a residual U-Net, both under the nnU-Net recipe and each tuned independently.
blocks.zh: 这两个轴线跨越三个成像领域——结肠镜多孔成像、乳房超声波和皮肤损伤皮肤镜,每个领域都有一个训练源和连续试验装置,提供了8套分散试验装置,其中一个(CVC-T)包括另一个(CVC-CoronDB;第3.2节)的图像。 基础模型是一台DINOv2-Small编码器,最小线性解码器,在跨越385万到2210万可列车参数的战略下进行改造. 具体任务参照系统是一个简单的U-Net和一个残余的U-Net,在nnU-Net的配方下,每个都独立调制.

blocks.en: The contributions are threefold: 1. A controlled comparison of foundation-model adaptation against task-specific training from scratch, with the evaluation regimes separated throughout and against baselines shown to be competitive with published architectures under an identical protocol: adaptation leads on all eight out-of-distribution test sets in DSC, IoU, sensitivity and HD95 under both architectures and its advantage grows as training data shrinks within a domain, most clearly in polyp, while in domain at the full training set no accuracy advantage was observed. 2. Empirical findings on adaptation capacity: the step from a frozen encoder to bias-only tuning captures most of the available benefit in polyp and breast, LoRA at 2.7 per cent of the parameters is equal or ahead of full fine-tuning in DSC on all five polyp sets across three seeds, and the capacity a domain requires is a property of the domain rather than of the method supplying it. 3. Practical recommendations for choosing between and evaluating the two approaches: when adaptation is warranted, how much capacity to use and how to select it, which failure modes to check before deployment, and which evaluation hazards in standard benchmarks to control.
blocks.zh: 捐款有三个方面: 1. 从零开始对照特定任务培训对基本模型的适应进行有控制的比较,评价制度在整个过程中和在基线上相互分离,显示与相同协议下公布的架构具有竞争力:在DSC、IoU、敏感度和HD95的所有8套分配外测试中,随着培训数据在一个域内收缩,最明显的是多普领域收缩,在域内没有观察到准确性优势,因此在结构下,敏感度和HD95的优势都有所增加。 2. 关于适应能力的经验结论:从一个冷冻编码器到只偏偏调取聚磷酸酯和乳腺的大部分可用惠益的步骤,LORA值2.7%的参数等于或领先于DSC对跨越三个种子的所有五个聚磷酸酯集的全面微调,一个域所需要的能力是域属性,而不是提供域的方法属性. 3. 在两种方法之间作出选择和评估的切实建议:何时需要适应,使用能力如何以及如何选择,在部署之前哪些模式无法检查,以及标准基准中有哪些评估风险可以控制。

blocks.en: A controlled comparison of foundation-model adaptation against task-specific training from scratch, with the evaluation regimes separated throughout and against baselines shown to be competitive with published architectures under an identical protocol: adaptation leads on all eight out-of-distribution test sets in DSC, IoU, sensitivity and HD95 under both architectures and its advantage grows as training data shrinks within a domain, most clearly in polyp, while in domain at the full training set no accuracy advantage was observed.
blocks.zh: 从零开始对照特定任务培训对基础模型的适应进行有控制地比较,整个评价制度和基线之间相互分离,显示在同一个协议下与已公布的架构具有竞争力:在DSC、IoU、敏感度和HD95中所有8套分配外测试中,在两种架构下的适应性都领先,其优势随着培训数据在一个域内收缩,最明显的是多普,而在域内,在全面培训中没有发现准确性优势。

blocks.en: Empirical findings on adaptation capacity: the step from a frozen encoder to bias-only tuning captures most of the available benefit in polyp and breast, LoRA at 2.7 per cent of the parameters is equal or ahead of full fine-tuning in DSC on all five polyp sets across three seeds, and the capacity a domain requires is a property of the domain rather than of the method supplying it.
blocks.zh: 关于适应能力的经验结论:从一个冷冻编码器到只偏偏调法的步骤,捕捉了多肽和乳腺中的大部分可用惠益,LORA值2.7%的参数等于或领先于DSC对横跨三个种子的所有五个多肽集的全面微调,一个域所需要的能力是域的属性,而不是提供它的方法.

blocks.en: Practical recommendations for choosing between and evaluating the two approaches: when adaptation is warranted, how much capacity to use and how to select it, which failure modes to check before deployment, and which evaluation hazards in standard benchmarks to control.
blocks.zh: 在两种办法之间作出选择和评估的切实建议:何时需要适应,使用能力如何以及如何选择,在部署之前哪些模式无法检查,以及标准基准中有哪些评估风险可以控制。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Medical image segmentation spans a wide range of imaging modalities, including X-ray radiography [ 9 ] , computed tomography (CT) [ 25 , 3 ] , magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) [ 43 , 51 ] , ultrasound [ 2 ] , colonoscopy [ 7 , 32 ] , dermoscopy [ 11 , 20 , 19 ] , fundus photography [ 54 , 35 ] and optical coherence tomography (OCT) [ 14 , 45 ] . These modalities differ in how the image is formed, in the appearance and scale of the anatomical targets and in how much annotated data is available, and each has accumulated its own methods and benchmarks. The three domains studied here, colonoscopy, breast ultrasound and dermoscopy, are drawn from this range, and the remainder of this section reviews the segmentation architectures, foundation models, adaptation methods and evaluation practices on which the study builds.
blocks.zh: 医学影像分解跨越广泛的成像模式,包括X射线射线摄影[9],计算成像(CT)[25,3],磁共振成像(MRI)[43,51],超声[2],结肠镜[7,32],皮肤镜[11,20,19],Fundus摄影[54,35]和光学一致性成像(OCT)[14,45]. 这些模式在图像的形成方式、解剖目标的外观和规模以及有多少附加说明的数据方面各不相同,而且每个模式都积累了自己的方法和基准。 这里研究的三个领域,即结肠镜学、乳房超声学和皮肤镜学,都来自这一范围,本节其余部分审查研究所依据的分解结构、基础模型、适应方法和评价做法。

blocks.en: 2.1 Segmentation architectures and nnU-Net
blocks.zh: 2.1 分区结构和nU-Net

blocks.en: Before deep learning, segmentation methods were typically designed around the anatomy and appearance of a single task, for example graph cuts for retinal vessels [ 53 ] and for retinal layers in OCT [ 13 , 15 ] , and Gaussian mixture and other probabilistic models for vessel extraction [ 34 , 35 ] . Learned encoder–decoder networks have since largely replaced such pipelines, although task-specific deep architectures continue to be proposed for individual targets such as colonoscopy polyps [ 21 , 67 , 29 , 16 ] . The U-Net of Ronneberger et al. [52] still dominates medical segmentation, and of the many variants proposed since, McConnell et al. [41] , comparing residual, dense, inception and attention families across eight datasets, conclude that none dominates and that the optimal choice is dataset-dependent. nnU-Net [ 30 ] reframed how such comparisons should be conducted by proposing a procedure rather than an architecture: it derives the network topology, patch size, resampling strategy, batch size and training schedule from a fingerprint of the dataset, and its central empirical claim, that a U-Net so configured matches or exceeds most published architectural modifications, makes the configuration of a baseline a methodological question rather than an implementation detail. That claim was sharpened in nnU-Net Revisited [ 31 ] , which finds that many papers claiming to outperform U-Net do so against a weakly configured instance of it, and which also reports strong performance from residual-encoder nnU-Net configurations, evaluated on three-dimensional multi-class segmentation across large datasets. Both results shape the design here: a residual variant, in the spirit of those configurations but with residual blocks in both encoder and decoder, was adopted as the primary task-specific baseline, and the 2015 architecture was deliberately not used, since employing it would have reproduced the weak-baseline error in the direction that flatters the conclusions drawn here.
blocks.zh: 在深入学习之前,分解方法通常围绕一个单一任务的解剖学和外观来设计,例如视网膜容器[53]和OCT[13,15]的视网膜层的图切割,以及高斯混合物和其他用于船舶提取的概率模型[34,35]. 已学到的编码器-编码器网络自此基本上取代了这种管道,尽管针对特定任务的深层架构继续被提议用于个别目标,例如结肠镜片[21、67、29、16]。 Ronneberger 等人的U-Net。 [52] 医学分化仍然占主导地位,在此后提出的许多变体中,McConnell等人. [41] 比较了8个数据集的剩余、密集、初始和关注家庭,得出的结论是,没有哪个数据集占主导地位,最佳选择是依赖数据集。 nnU-Net[30]重新界定了如何通过提出一个程序而不是一个架构来进行这种比较:它从数据集的指纹中得出网络地形、补丁大小、再取样战略、批量大小和培训时间表,以及其中央经验论,即一个如此配置的U-Net匹配或超过大多数公布的建筑修改,使基线的配置成为一个方法问题,而不是一个执行细节。 这一说法在nnU-Net Revisisited [31]中更加明确,其中发现许多声称优于U-Net的论文是针对一个配置薄弱的例子而做的,而且它们还报告了剩余编码器nnU-Net配置的强效性能,这些配置在大数据集的三维多级分解上得到了评价。 这两种结果都塑造了这里的设计:根据这些配置的精神,但有编码器和解码器中残余块的残余变体被采纳为主要的任务特定基准,2015年的架构被故意不使用,因为使用它本会重现此处得出的结论所遵循的方向的弱基线错误.

blocks.en: 2.2 Foundation models and their medical adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.2 基础模型及其医疗适应

blocks.en: DINOv2 [ 48 ] is trained self-supervised on 142 million curated natural images with no labels, and its patch-level features transfer to dense prediction without task-specific supervision during pretraining. Because it has never seen a segmentation mask, whether its representations transfer to medical segmentation is a question about representational generality rather than about label overlap, which is why it was selected here. Its medical transfer has been assessed by Baharoon et al. [5] across nine radiology benchmarks and by Ayzenberg et al. [4] in few-shot segmentation, and Li et al. [39] report that pairing DINO features with a U-Net decoder supplies a strong inductive prior for medical segmentation.
blocks.zh: DINOv2[48]在1.42亿条无标签的编译自然图像上接受自我监督训练,其补丁级特征在预训期间在没有任务特定监督的情况下转移到密集预测. 因为它从未见过分化面具,所以其表示性转移到医疗分化是否是一个关于代表性的泛泛而非标签重叠的问题,这就是它之所以被选在这里的原因. 其医疗转移已由Baharoon等人评估. [5]跨越9个放射学基准,由艾岑伯格等人撰写. [4] 在几弹分解中,与李等人. [39] 报告说,将DINO特征与U-Net解码器配对,在医疗分解前提供强导体。

blocks.en: The second family originates with the Segment Anything Model [ 37 ] , trained on a billion masks over eleven million images, and is adapted to medical images by retraining on large-scale medical data [ 40 ] , by applying LoRA to the image encoder [ 66 ] , by large-scale two-dimensional adaptation [ 10 ] or by inserting adapters into a frozen backbone [ 65 ] ; SAM-Mamba [ 18 ] reports strong cross-dataset polyp performance and appears in the comparison of Section 4.2 . A model supervised on segmentation masks and a model that has never seen one require different amounts of adaptation to reach a medical target, so a finding about how much adaptation one needs does not automatically transfer to the other (Section 5.5 ).
blocks.zh: 第二家族起源于分块"Anything Model [37],接受过十亿口罩培训的超过1100万张图像,通过对大规模医疗数据的再培训来适应医疗图像[40],通过将LORA应用到图像编码器[66],通过大规模二维适应[10]或将适配器插入冷冻骨干[65];SAM-Mamba[18]报告强跨数据集多肽性能,并出现在第4.2节的比较中. 在分解口罩上监督的模型和从未见过的模型需要不同程度的适应才能达到医疗目标,因此,关于一个人需要多少适应的发现不会自动转移到另一个(第5.5节)。

blocks.en: 2.3 Parameter-efficient adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.3 参数高效适应

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient methods update a small fraction of a pretrained model’s parameters, avoiding the memory and storage cost of full fine-tuning and, on small target datasets, the risk of destabilising representations that took large-scale pretraining to acquire. Adapter modules [ 26 ] and visual prompt tuning [ 33 ] add computation at inference, which is the property LoRA avoids. LoRA [ 28 ] freezes the pretrained weights and adds a trainable low-rank decomposition to selected projections, so that the effective weight update is constrained to rank r r ; the rank controls the capacity of the update and is the method’s principal hyperparameter, and because the adapters can be merged into the base weights after training, inference cost is unchanged. Kalajdzievski [36] shows that the conventional scaling factor slows learning and stunts performance at higher ranks and proposes a rank-stabilised alternative, which is why the present work holds the scaling constant so that the rank sweep of Section 4.5 varies rank and nothing else. BitFit [ 6 ] freezes all weight matrices and trains only bias terms, under one tenth of one per cent of the parameters in the models it was proposed for, and its authors report performance competitive with full fine-tuning on language tasks with the advantage concentrated in low-data regimes. The absence of a rank parameter and its different intervention site make it the natural control for testing whether a capacity requirement is a property of low-rank factorisation or of the target, which is the role it serves in Section 4.5 .
blocks.zh: 参数高效方法更新了一小部分预先训练过的模型的参数,避免了全面微调的内存和存储成本,在小型目标数据集上,避免了需要大规模预先训练才能获得的不稳定表述的风险. 适配器模块 [26] 和视觉即时调制 [33] 在推论中添加计算,这是LORA避免的属性. LoRA [28] 冻结了预先训练的重量,并在选定的预测中增加了一个可训练的低级分解,这样有效的重量更新就会被限制在r r 的排位;分量控制更新的能力,是方法的主要超参数,由于适配器在训练后可以合并到基重,推论成本不变. Kalajdzievski [36] 显示常规的缩放因子在较高级别上慢了学习和特技表现,并提出了一个稳定军衔的替代方案,这就是为什么目前的工作保持了缩放常数,这样4.5节的排位扫射就不同了,没有其他的了. BitFit [6] 将所有重量矩阵和列车只冻结在偏差条件,低于它所建议的模型参数的十分之一,其作者报告其性能具有竞争力,对语言任务进行了全面微调,优势集中在低数据制度. 由于没有等级参数及其不同的干预站点,它成为测试能力要求是低等级保理化还是目标属性的自然控制,这是它在第4.5节中的作用.

blocks.en: The literature applying these methods to medical imaging contains an unresolved disagreement, and it is the point at which this study enters. Dutt et al. [17] benchmark parameter-efficient methods across medical image analysis tasks and report an ordering that depends on data volume: in their HAM10000 classification experiment with ViT-Large, LoRA overtakes full fine-tuning from approximately eighty per cent of the available data downward, while BitFit is superior only below twenty per cent. Teuber et al. [58] evaluate parameter-efficient adaptation of SAM across biomedical datasets and report instead that the relative effectiveness of these methods differs by dataset in a way that data volume alone does not account for, and that for computational efficiency, where in the encoder a method intervenes matters more than which method it is. The two are not straightforwardly reconcilable, and no study separates them, which would require varying data volume within a domain while comparing across domains at matched volume. Section 5.5 returns to the disagreement with results in hand.
blocks.zh: 将这些方法应用于医学成像的文献中包含了一个尚未解决的分歧,这也是本研究进入的阶段. Dutt 等 (英语). [17] 整个医疗图像分析任务的基准参数高效方法,并报告一个取决于数据量的订单:在使用ViT-Large的HAM1000分类实验中,LORA从大约80%的现有数据向下完全完成微调,而BitFit的优势仅低于20%. Teuber等人著. [58] 评价SAM跨生物医学数据集的参数效率适应,并报告这些方法的相对有效性因数据集的不同而有所不同,其方式是数据量本身并不能说明问题,而对于计算效率,在编码器中,一种方法比它是什么方法更重要。 两者并非可直接调和的,没有一项研究将它们分开,这就需要在某一域内有不同的数据量,同时按相应量对不同域进行比较。 第5.5节回到与手头结果的分歧。

blocks.en: 2.4 Cross-dataset evaluation and data hygiene
blocks.zh: 2.4 跨数据集评价和数据卫生

blocks.en: Most published results are obtained on held-out data from the training source, which is not the deployment setting, and under a consistent protocol well-tuned empirical risk minimisation is competitive with most proposed domain generalisation algorithms [ 23 ] . The protocol of Fan et al. [21] partitions five polyp collections into a fixed training portion and three held-out sets, and its widespread adoption means published scores are comparable in experimental setup rather than merely in metric, which is what permits the baselines here to be positioned against the literature. U-Bench [ 57 ] evaluates 100 U-Net variants across 28 datasets and 10 modalities, reserving eight unseen datasets for zero-shot evaluation, and reports that in-domain metrics have largely saturated while zero-shot generalisation continues to separate methods. Ndipenoch et al. [45] apply the same distinction within medical segmentation, comparing an adapted SAM against nnU-Net variants across three OCT device vendors and reporting the task-specific models slightly ahead. A domain qualifies for such a study only if it offers a training source with independently acquired, comparably annotated, public test sets; three satisfy this and were chosen to differ in modality, by a factor of more than four in training-set size, and in severity of shift. Selecting domains that differ this way is what makes it possible to ask whether a regularity is a property of a method or of the data it was measured on, which a single-domain study cannot ask.
blocks.zh: 大多数公布的结果来自培训来源(不是部署设置)的搁置数据,根据一致的协议,经过充分调整的经验风险最小化与大多数拟议的域通用算法具有竞争力[23]。 范 et等的规程. [21] 将5个聚P集分为固定培训部分和3个停放集,其广泛采用意味着公布的分数在实验设置中是可比的,而不是仅仅在度量法中,这就使得这里的基线能够与文献相对立. U-Bench [57] 在28个数据集和10个模式中评价了100个U-Net变体,为零镜头评价保留了8个看不见的数据集,并报告说,域内度量度基本饱和,而零镜头泛化继续分离方法. Ndipenoch 等 (英语). [45] 在医疗分割方面适用同样的区别,将三个OCT设备供应商经过调整的SAM与nnU-Net的变体进行比较,并略提前报告具体任务模式。 只有当一个领域提供独立获得的、有相当说明的公共测试集的培训来源时,它才有资格进行这种研究;有三个领域满足了这一点,被选择在模式上有所不同,在培训设定的规模和轮班的严重程度方面,其系数超过四个。 选择这样不同的域,是能够问一个规律是方法的属性还是它所测量的数据的属性,而单个域的研究是不能问的.

blocks.en: Cross-dataset evaluation is only as sound as the separation between the sets compared. Truong et al. [59] report that medical datasets often contain near-duplicate images that can bias evaluation, identifying possible near-duplicates in the widely used Medical Segmentation Decathlon and benchmarking their detection under transformations that include cropping and compression. On metrics, Taha and Hanbury [56] set out the consequences of choosing among them. On representations, centred kernel alignment [ 38 ] is the standard tool for comparing representations across networks, and Nguyen et al. [46] use the debiased estimator adopted in Section 4.6 .
blocks.zh: 跨数据集评价的正确性仅相当于各套之间比较的分离. 特鲁翁等. [59] 报告说,医疗数据集中往往含有可能偏向评价的近似复制图像,在广泛使用的医学分解Decathlon中识别可能的近似复制,并在包括裁剪和压缩在内的转换中设定检测基准。 关于衡量标准,塔哈和汉伯里[56]阐述了在其中选择的后果。 在表达方式方面,中心内核对齐[38]是比较跨网络表达方式的标准工具,Nguyen等人. [46] 使用第4.6节中采用的无偏见估计方法。

blocks.en: 2.5 Research gaps
blocks.zh: 2.5 研究差距

blocks.en: Three gaps follow. 1. When adaptation should be preferred. The literature does not settle when one approach should be preferred over the other, because comparisons are typically made within the training distribution and against a baseline whose configuration is not itself defended, the weakness nnU-Net [ 30 ] and nnU-Net Revisited [ 31 ] identify in architectural comparisons. 2. How much adaptation a target requires. Separating the data-volume effects and dataset-dependent outcomes of Section 2.3 requires varying data volume within a domain while comparing across domains at matched volume, and testing the same question under two methods that share no mechanism, so that any regularity found cannot be a property of one method’s parameterisation. 3. How far the answers depend on configuration. nnU-Net Revisited [ 31 ] and U-Bench [ 57 ] reach their conclusions by breadth, evaluating many methods under a common protocol, which leaves little room to vary the configuration of any one comparison. This study varies data volume on the architecture axis and compares domains and methods on the adaptation axis; the interaction between capacity requirement and data volume is left open (Section 5.4 ). For the third gap it takes the complementary trade-off, few methods examined at many operating points, which is the reason it covers three domains and two adaptation methods, examining their sensitivity to adaptation rank, training budget and evaluation regime.
blocks.zh: 后结三障. 1. 应选择适应。 文献并没有解决何时应采用一种办法而不是另一种办法的问题,因为比较通常是在培训分配范围内进行的,而且对照一个其配置本身没有辩护的基线,薄弱环节nU-Net[30]和nU-Net[31]在建筑比较中查明。 2. 目标需要多少适应。 分离第2.3节的数据量效应和依赖数据集的结果需要域内不同的数据量,同时按匹配的量对域进行比较,并在没有机制的两种方法下测试同一问题,这样发现的任何规律性都不能成为一种方法参数化的属性. 3. 答案取决于配置的程度。 nnU-Net Revisibed [31] and U-Bench [57] 以宽度得出了结论,评价了共同协议下的许多方法,这为改变任何一种比较的配置留下了很小的余地. 本研究对架构轴的数据量有差异,并比较了适应轴上的域和方法;能力要求与数据量之间的相互作用没有变化(第5.4节)。 就第三个差距而言,它需要互补的权衡,许多操作点所审查的方法很少,因此它涉及三个领域和两个适应方法,审查它们对适应等级、培训预算和评价制度的敏感性。

The literature does not settle when one approach should be preferred over the other, because comparisons are typically made within the training distribution and against a baseline whose configuration is not itself defended, the weakness nnU-Net [ 30 ] and nnU-Net Revisited [ 31 ] identify in architectural comparisons.

Separating the data-volume effects and dataset-dependent outcomes of Section 2.3 requires varying data volume within a domain while comparing across domains at matched volume, and testing the same question under two methods that share no mechanism, so that any regularity found cannot be a property of one method’s parameterisation.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Design and scope
blocks.zh: 3.1 设计和范围

blocks.en: The foundation model adopted is DINOv2 [ 48 ] , in its smallest variant. It was chosen deliberately in preference to segmentation-specific or medical foundation models such as SAM [ 37 ] , which is trained on a billion masks, and SAMed [ 66 ] , which fine-tunes SAM on medical images. The aim is to demonstrate the effectiveness of the adaptation approach with a small, general-purpose model that has never been trained on segmentation masks or medical images, so that any advantage it shows can be attributed to adaptation rather than to prior exposure to the target task or domain. Such a model represents a conservative case: if it suffices, larger foundation models, and those pretrained on masks or medical data, would be expected to perform at least as well. A finding about how much adaptation one model family needs does not, however, automatically transfer to another (Section 2.2 ), and repeating the adaptation axis on SAM, which SAMed adapts with LoRA in the same way as the configurations here, is left to future work (Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 采用的基础模型为DINOv2[48],以最小的变体表示. 特意选择了分化特异性或医学基础模型,如SAM[37],训练了十亿个口罩,SAMed[66],微调了SAM的医疗影像. 目的是用一个从未受过分化口罩或医疗图像培训的小型通用模型来展示适应方法的有效性,从而使它显示的任何优势都能够归因于适应,而不是先前接触目标任务或领域. 这样的模型代表了一个保守的情况:如果足够的话,更大的基础模型,以及那些在口罩或医疗数据上预先受过训练的模型,至少也应该发挥出来。 然而,关于一个模式家庭需要多少适应,不能自动转移到另一个模式(第2.2节),以及重复SAM上的适应轴线(SAMed以与这里的配置相同的方式与LORA进行适应),则留待未来工作处理(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: The design is organised around two axes kept separate throughout, summarised in Fig. 1 . The architecture axis asks when adaptation outperforms task-specific training: an adapted DINOv2 encoder is compared against a plain U-Net and a residual U-Net (ResU-Net) trained from random initialisation. The adaptation axis asks how much adaptation is required: the foundation model is compared only against itself under strategies of increasing capacity. No task-specific model appears on the adaptation axis, and no adaptation strategy is applied to the task-specific architectures, which have no pretrained parameters to adapt.
blocks.zh: 设计围绕两条轴线排列,两条轴线一直分开,在Fig中概述. 1 (英语). 架构轴询问适应在何时超越任务特定训练:一个经过改造的DINOv2编码器被比作一个普通的U-Net和一个通过随机初始化训练的剩余U-Net(ResU-Net). 适应轴线询问需要多少适应:在能力提高的战略下,只将基础模型与其自身进行比较。 适应轴上没有出现特定任务的模型,也没有适应战略适用于特定任务的架构,这些架构没有经过预先训练的参数可以适应.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Experimental design. The architecture axis compares an adapted DINOv2 against two models trained from random initialisation; the adaptation axis compares seven configurations of the same model by trainable parameter count. The two intersect at LoRA rank 32, selected on in-domain validation. All comparisons run across three domains and eight out-of-distribution test sets.
blocks.zh: 图 1:实验设计. 架构轴将一个经过改造的DINOv2比作两个通过随机初始化训练的模型;适应轴通过可训练参数计数来比较同一个模型的七个配置. 两个交叉点在LORA第32位,选在域内验证上. 所有比较都涉及三个领域和八套分配外测试。

blocks.en: The adaptation axis is conditional on the architecture axis, and the two intersect at a single point rather than as a factorial design. Only one DINOv2 configuration enters the architecture-axis comparison, selected on in-domain validation rather than imported from the rank sweep, and results from one axis are not used to support claims about the other. Claims on the adaptation axis consequently rest on a single backbone, a limitation returned to in Section 5.4 .
blocks.zh: 适应轴以建筑轴为条件,两者在一个点上交汇,而不是作为因素设计. 只有一种DINOv2配置进入架构轴比较,选择在域内验证上,而不是从排名扫描中导入,一个轴的结果不用于支持对另一个轴的主张. 因此,关于适应轴的索赔以单一主干为主干线,第5.4节中重述了这一限制。

blocks.en: All models share training splits, evaluation code and metric definitions. Augmentation and optimiser settings differ by model family, the task-specific models using a stronger pipeline than the adaptation experiments. Where budgets or learning rates differ it is because each configuration runs at its own selected setting rather than an arbitrary shared one, and each such difference is identified where it occurs. Where multi-seed results exist the seed-averaged value is used, which on the architecture axis affects the skin domain only.
blocks.zh: 所有模式都共享培训分拆、评价守则和计量定义。 增强和选择性环境因模式家族不同而不同,任务特定模式使用比适应实验更强的管道. 在预算或学习率不同的地方,这是因为每个配置都按照自己选定的环境运行,而不是任意共享,而且每个这种差异都在发生地点。 如果存在多种子结果,则使用种子平均值,这在结构轴上仅影响皮肤域.

blocks.en: The use of three domains is a methodological choice rather than a matter of scale. A recurring finding of this work is that a regularity observed in one domain does not hold in the next, which a single-domain study is structurally unable to detect.
blocks.zh: 使用三个领域是方法选择,而不是规模问题。 这项工作的一个反复出现的发现是,在一个领域观察到的规律性在下一个领域并不存在,一个单一领域研究在结构上无法检测到.

blocks.en: 3.2 Domains, datasets and leakage control
blocks.zh: 3.2 域、数据集和渗漏控制

blocks.en: Three domains were selected to span imaging modality, training-set size and severity of distribution shift, for the reasons given in Section 2.4 . Each provides one training source and held-out test sets acquired by different institutions or under different protocols, with the exception reported below. After cleaning, the training and validation splits contain 1,305 and 145 images in polyp, 479 and 54 in breast, and 2,075 and 519 in skin (Table 2 ); test-set sizes are given in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 由于第2.4节所述原因,选定了三个领域,以涵盖成像模式、培训设定的规模和分布转移的严重程度。 每种都提供一种培训来源和由不同机构或根据不同协议获得的预留测试设备,下文报告的除外。 清洗后,培训和鉴定分片包含1 305幅和145幅多肽图像,479幅和54幅乳房图像,2 075幅和519幅皮肤图像(表2);测试大小见表5。

blocks.en: Table 1: Datasets by domain; counts are images after cleaning. Asterisks mark skin sets drawn from the same archive as the training data.
blocks.zh: 表1:按域分列的数据集;计数为清理后的图像. Asterisks标记了从培训数据相同的档案中提取的皮肤。

blocks.en: Table 2: Leakage detection by domain.
blocks.zh: 表2:按域分列的泄漏检测.

blocks.en: Polyp combines Kvasir-SEG [ 32 ] and CVC-ClinicDB [ 7 ] under the protocol of Fan et al. [21] , with CVC-ColonDB [ 8 ] , ETIS-LaribPolypDB [ 55 ] and CVC-T [ 62 ] held out; the protocol was adopted because its widespread use makes published scores comparable in setup, which permits the task-specific baselines to be positioned against the literature in Section 4.2 . Breast uses BUSI [ 2 ] with BrEaST [ 50 ] and BUS-UCLM [ 61 ] held out, each acquired at a different institution, and four BUS-UCLM images with mismatched mask dimensions were excluded. Skin uses ISIC 2018 [ 12 , 60 ] with filtered subsets of ISIC 2016 [ 24 ] and ISIC 2017 [ 11 ] and the independent PH2 collection [ 42 ] . Breast has no separate in-domain test set, so its validation split serves that role. In skin the validation split was used for model selection only and is not reported as an in-domain result, so skin contributes to the out-of-distribution comparison alone. One caveat is carried to the discussion: although held out entirely, ISIC 2016* and 2017* originate from the same archive as the training data and represent a milder shift than the polyp or breast sets, PH2 being the only genuinely independent skin source. All datasets used here are publicly available and were released for research use by their original providers, and no new human data were collected.
blocks.zh: Polyp将Kvasir-SEG[32]和CVC-ClinicDB[7]根据Fan等人的协议结合. [21],随着CVC-CoronDB [8],ETIS-LaribPolypDB [55]和CVC-T [62]的坚持;协议之所以获得通过,是因为其广泛使用使得公布的分数在设定上具有可比性,这使得任务特定基线能够与第4.2节文献相对立. 乳房使用BUSI [2] 与BrEaST [50] 和 BUS-UCLM [61] 相持,各自在不同的机构获得,四个带有不匹配口罩尺寸的BUS-UCLM图像被排除在外. Skin使用ISIC 2018 [12,60],其过滤子集为ISIC 2016 [24]和ISIC 2017 [11],独立的PH2集[42]. 乳房没有单独的域内测试集,因此其验证分裂为这个角色服务. 在皮肤中,验证分裂只用于模型选择,不报告为域内结果,因此皮肤只有助于分配外比较. 讨论需要注意一点:国际标准行业分类2016年* 和2017年* 虽然完全如此,但来源于与培训数据相同的档案,比多肽或乳房套装更温和,PH2是唯一真正独立的皮肤来源。 这里使用的所有数据集都是公开的,并被发布给其原始提供者用于研究,没有收集新的人类数据.

blocks.en: Fig. 2 shows one annotated case from each training source alongside cases from that domain’s out-of-distribution sets, illustrating the variation in illumination, field of view and annotation convention the cross-dataset evaluation measures.
blocks.zh: 图2显示每个培训来源的一个附加说明的案例,以及来自该领域分配外的一组案例,说明跨数据集评价措施在照明、视野和注释公约方面的差异。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Example cases from each domain. One image per dataset with its ground-truth contour in yellow; images are centre-cropped to a common square footprint and are otherwise unmodified. The training source of each domain is framed in colour, with one of polyp’s two training sources shown, and every other set is held out. Breast has one fewer test set than the other two domains, since only two independent breast ultrasound sources with segmentation masks were available. The asterisk marks skin test sets drawn from the same archive as the training source.
blocks.zh: 图 2:每个领域的案例。 每个数据集有一个图像,其地面真实轮廓为黄色;图像被中央固定在共同的方形足迹上,否则无法修改。 每个领域的培训来源都以颜色为框架,并显示一个多语种的两个培训来源,并保持其他所有的培训来源。 乳房的测试装置比其他两个领域少一个,因为只有两个独立的乳房超声波源,有分片口罩。 星号标记了皮肤测试集 从相同的档案中抽取与训练源。

blocks.en: Cross-dataset evaluation is meaningful only if the test sets are genuinely unseen. Where overlap goes undetected, out-of-distribution scores are inflated by an unquantifiable amount and the comparison this study rests on becomes uninterpretable, so each domain was examined before any experiment was run, with a method suited to its failure mode (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 只有当测试集真正被忽略时,交叉数据集评价才有意义。 如果重叠未被发现,分配外的分数被一个不可量化的数量夸大,而本研究的比较就变得无法解释,因此在进行任何实验之前就对每个领域进行了审查,并采用了适合其失败模式的方法(表2)。

blocks.en: In polyp the protocol partitions the sources into disjoint portions, so the residual risk is accidental duplication, and md5 hashing found no collisions; it is the weakest method, failing on any re-encoding, but adequate since the collections are distributed separately. In skin, because the ISIC archive preserves identifiers across releases, overlap was found by matching filename stems, and matches were removed from the test sets rather than the training set, preserving the training distribution. This renders the skin results non-comparable with published scores on the full ISIC test sets, accepted because an uncontaminated smaller set is preferable to a contaminated comparable one. Breast required the most preparation. Of 780 images, 133 are normal cases with empty masks and were removed, and the remaining 647 contain near-duplicates that md5 hashing largely misses: a perceptual hash at a Hamming distance of five or less placed 212 of them in 98 groups, only one of which contains byte-identical files, and keeping one image per group removed 114, leaving 533. Inspection of a sample of four groups showed the same acquisitions annotated twice with differing masks, so their presence would constitute a leak carrying contradictory labels. The count depends on the threshold, from 89 removed images at a distance of three to 137 at eight.
blocks.zh: 在多聚体中,协议将源分解成脱节部分,因此残余风险是偶然重复的,Md5散列物没有发现碰撞;这是最弱的方法,在任何重编码上都失败了,但因为收集物是分开分配的,所以足够了。 在皮肤上,由于国际标准行业分类档案保存了各种释放的识别资料,因此通过匹配文件名源来发现重叠之处,从测试组而不是培训组中删除匹配之处,保留培训分布。 这使得皮肤结果无法与国际标准行业分类全部测试组的公布分数相比较,因为未受污染的小型测试组比受污染的类似测试组更可取。 乳房最需要准备 在780幅图像中,133幅是普通的带空口罩的病例并被移除,其余647幅包含Md5散射大部分缺失的近似重复:在汉明距离5幅或更少的距离上,将212幅图像放置在98组中,其中只有1幅包含字节相同的文件,每组保留1幅图像被移除114幅,留下533幅. 对四组样本的检查显示,同样的采购有两次附加说明,但口罩不同,因此这些采购的存在将构成带有自相矛盾标签的泄漏。 计数取决于阈值,从距离3到8时137的89幅被移除的图像.

blocks.en: Checking the test sets against one another, which the protocol does not require, showed that two of them are not independent: all 60 CVC-T images are pixel-identical to images in CVC-ColonDB, as are 59 of their 60 masks, while none of the files is byte-identical, so the md5 check applied to the training data would not have detected the overlap. CVC-T is retained because it belongs to the standard protocol and to the published comparisons of Section 4.2 , but its results are not independent evidence alongside CVC-ColonDB, and polyp therefore contributes two independent out-of-distribution sources rather than three. The overlap is consistent with the provenance of the data: the EndoScene benchmark from which CVC-T is drawn defines its images as CVC-ColonDB (300 images from 13 sequences) together with CVC-ClinicDB (612 images) [ 62 ] .
blocks.zh: 互相检查测试集,而协议并不要求这样做,这表明其中两个集不独立:全部60个CVC-T图像与CVC-CoronDB中的图像是像素-等同的,如同他们的60个口罩中的59个一样,而所有文件都不是字节-等同的,因此应用于训练数据的md5检查不会发现重叠. CVC-T之所以被保留,是因为它属于标准协议和第4.2节的已公布比较,但其结果与CVC-CoronDB不是独立的证据,因此polyp贡献了两个独立的分散源而不是三个. 重叠与数据来源一致:从中绘制CVC-T的EndoScene基准将其图像定义为CVC-CoronDB(来自13个序列的300个图像),加上CVC-ClinicDB(612个图像)[62].

blocks.en: 3.3 Adaptation strategies
blocks.zh: 3.3 适应战略

blocks.en: All adaptation experiments use a DINOv2-Small encoder [ 48 ] , the smallest of the released variants at 22.1 million parameters against 1.1 billion for the largest, with a linear decoder head: a single 1 × 1 1{\times}1 convolution mapping the 384-dimensional patch embeddings to a one-channel logit map, bilinearly upsampled to the input resolution, containing 385 parameters (Fig. 3 c). This minimality is intentional: a heavier decoder would absorb part of the adaptation and confound the question of how much the encoder must change. Two consequences bound what Section 4 shows. The frozen configuration should be read as a minimal baseline; Li et al. [39] combine a frozen DINOv3 backbone with an adapter, a projection module and a U-Net-style decoder, a substantially different architecture. And the adapted model is not intended to compete with architectures developed for a specific task, which pair large encoders with multi-scale decoders of their own; Section 4.2 states that scope where published scores are introduced.
blocks.zh: 所有适应实验都使用DINov2-Small编码器[48],是释放的变体中最小的2,210万参数,对最大值为11亿参数,其线性解码器头: 单 1× 1 × 1 =times}1 演化 将384维的补丁嵌入到一个单通道的对数图中,双线性地提升到输入分辨率,包含385参数(图3 c). 这种最小化是有意的:一个较重的解码器将吸收部分适应,并混淆了编码器必须改变多少的问题。 4节显示的两个后果 应将冻结的配置理解为最低限度的基线;Li等人。 [39] 将冷冻的DINOv3主干线与适配器,投影模块和U-Net式的解码器结合,结构大相径庭. 而改编的模型并不打算与为特定任务开发的架构竞争,这些架构将大型编码器与自行的多尺度解码器对齐;第4.2节规定引入已公布分数的范围.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Model architectures. (a) The five-level encoder–decoder topology shared by both task-specific comparators. (b) One block in each variant. The two differ in the residual addition and its projection shortcut, applied in both encoder and decoder, while widths, normalisation, activation, downsampling and training recipe are identical. (c) The adapted model: a DINOv2-Small encoder producing 384-dimensional patch embeddings, reduced to a one-channel logit map by a single 1 × 1 1{\times}1 convolution of 385 parameters and upsampled to the input resolution. The magnified block shows where each adaptation strategy intervenes. Blue marks parameters held frozen and red marks parameters updated.
blocks.zh: 图3:示范建筑. (a) 两个任务特定参照国共有的五级编码器-编码器地形。 (b) 每种变式各一个区块。 两者在剩余添加及其投影快捷方式上有所不同,既适用于编码器,也适用于解码器,而宽度,正常化,激活,下采样和训练配方则相同. (c) 改编型号:一种DINov2-Small编码器,生产384维的补丁嵌入,由单1×1×1×1×时=1 演化出385个参数并提升到输入分辨率。 放大块显示每个适应战略干预的地方。 蓝色标记参数被冻结,红色标记参数被更新。

blocks.en: Seven configurations span the capacity axis (Table 3 ); their results by test set are given in Table 19 . The frozen configuration trains only the decoder and establishes how much of the task the pretrained representation already solves. BitFit [ 6 ] trains all encoder bias terms with the decoder; having no rank parameter and intervening throughout the encoder, it probes the capacity axis independently of LoRA’s mechanism, which is its role in Section 4.5 . LoRA is applied at ranks 4, 8, 16 and 32, with low-rank updates attached to the query and value projections of every attention block, the placement recommended by Hu et al. [28] , and scaling α = 2 ​ r \alpha=2r , holding α / r \alpha/r fixed so that the sweep varies rank alone. Dropout is 0.1, and rank-stabilised scaling [ 36 ] was disabled for the same reason. Full fine-tuning updates all encoder weights together with the decoder.
blocks.zh: 7个配置横跨容量轴(表3),其测试结果见表19。 被冻结的配置仅对解码器进行训练,并确定预先训练的表示器已经解决了多少任务. BitFit [6] 将所有的编码器偏差术语都与解码器一起进行训练;没有排名参数,并且在整个编码器中进行干预,它独立于LORA机制来探测容量轴,这是它在第4.5节中的作用. LoRA在第四,八,十六和三十二级应用,低等级更新附在每个关注区块的查询和值预测,胡等人建议的位置[28],缩放α = 2 r\ alpha=2r,持有α / r\ alpha/r固定,使扫荡单位不同. 中途退学为0.1,等级稳定比例[36]因同样原因停用. 全面微调与解码器一起更新所有编码器重量.

blocks.en: Table 3: Adaptation strategies on the capacity axis. Every configuration also trains the 385-parameter linear decoder, which is included in the trainable count; the percentage is relative to full fine-tuning. Q and V: query and value projections of every attention block.
blocks.zh: 表3:能力轴上的适应战略。 每个配置还训练385参数的线性解码器,该解码器包含在可列车计数中;百分比相对于全微调. Q和V:每个关注区块的查询和数值预测.

blocks.en: All strategies use AdamW with a two-epoch warmup, three for full fine-tuning, cosine decay, weight decay 1e-4 and early stopping on validation DSC. The optimiser, the schedule and the stopping rule are held identical across strategies by design, since the adaptation axis is intended to vary one thing, where and how many parameters are trained, and a schedule that moved with the strategy would confound that variation with it. The learning rate is the exception, for the reason given below. Zhang and Liu [66] report that warmup stabilises SAMed fine-tuning and that AdamW further improves performance. The frozen strategy trains its decoder at 1e-3, LoRA uses 1e-4 throughout, and full fine-tuning uses layer-wise decay [ 27 ] with a base encoder rate of 5e-6 decaying by 0.75 per layer, a decay within the range conventionally used for vision transformer fine-tuning. BitFit uses one optimiser group at 1e-3, 3e-3 and 1e-3 for polyp, breast and skin, selected over {1e-2, 3e-3, 1e-3, 3e-4} on in-domain validation.
blocks.zh: 所有策略都使用亚当W,带有两个时代的热身,三个用于全微调,余弦衰减,重量衰减1e-4,提前停止验证DSC. 由于适应轴旨在改变一个因素,即培训了哪些参数和多少参数,而且随着战略的移动,时间表将混淆这一变化。 学习率是例外,原因如下。 张和刘[66]报告说,暖气稳定SAMED微调,亚当W进一步提高了性能. 冷冻策略在1e-3,LORA全程使用1e-4的解码器,全微调使用层层式衰变[27],基码率5e-6衰变每层0.75,这是在常规范围内用于视变器微调的衰变. BitFit在域内验证时使用1e-3,3e-3和1e-3的Opimiser组用于多肽,乳腺和皮肤,选取于{1e-2,3e-3,3e-4}.

blocks.en: The governing principle is that each strategy is evaluated at its own selected setting rather than a shared one, and this is more consequential than it appears. An earlier run of this study trained full fine-tuning at a single flat encoder rate for a fixed fifteen epochs, without layer-wise decay or warmup, and under that configuration it appeared clearly inferior, a conclusion that would have been an artefact of the protocol rather than a property of the methods. One asymmetry follows: BitFit received a per-domain learning-rate search whereas LoRA and full fine-tuning did not, which favours BitFit, and Section 4.5 should be read accordingly.
blocks.zh: 指导性原则是,每项战略都按自己选定的环境而不是共同环境进行评估,这比看起来更为具有后果。 这项研究较早时就以一个固定的15个纪元的单一统一编码速率进行了全面微调,没有层层衰变或暖和,在这种布局下,它看起来明显低劣,这个结论本会是协议的异物而不是方法的属性。 以下为一种不对称现象: BitFit收到每个域的学习率搜索,而LORA和全微调则没有,这有利于BitFit,第4.5节应相应读取.

blocks.en: 3.4 Task-specific architectures
blocks.zh: 3.4 具体任务的架构

blocks.en: A comparison against one task-specific model leaves an evident objection: any deficit might reflect a weakness in that implementation rather than a property of task-specific training. Two architectures are therefore used, bracketing the task-specific axis (Fig. 3 a, b). The residual U-Net represents the residual design family and the plain U-Net the field’s conventional reference point, and if both fall behind the deficit cannot be attributed to a single architectural choice.
blocks.zh: 与某一具体任务模式相比,显然有反对意见:任何不足之处都可能反映执行工作的弱点,而不是具体任务培训的弱点。 因此采用了两种架构,将任务特定轴线(图3a、b)划为括号。 残余的U-Net代表残余设计家族和外地常规参考点的平原U-Net,如果两者都落后于赤字,则不能归因于单一的建筑选择。

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Residual U-Net
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 残余铀网

blocks.en: The residual variant is in the spirit of nnU-Net ResEnc [ 31 ] , with residual blocks in both encoder and decoder, trained under the nnU-Net recipe [ 30 ] : 8,114,692 parameters in a five-level encoder of base width 32 with residual blocks, instance normalisation, LeakyReLU and deep supervision at every decoder level. The original U-Net of Ronneberger et al. [52] was deliberately not adopted, since using the 2015 configuration would have reproduced the weak-baseline error in the direction that flatters this study.
blocks.zh: 剩余变体符合nU-NetResEnc[31]的精神,在编码器和解码器中都有剩余块,在nU-Net配方[30]下训练:8,114,692个参数在基宽度32的5级编码器中,有剩余块,实例正常化,LeakyReLU和每个解码器级的深度监管. 最初的Ronneberger等人的U-Net. [52] 故意没有被采用,因为使用2015年的配置本会重复本研究所向往的弱基线错误.

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Plain U-Net
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 普通U-Net

blocks.en: The plain variant is the plain convolutional U-Net that nnU-Net configures by default [ 30 , 31 ] , identical except that the residual addition and 1 × 1 1{\times}1 skip projection are removed, at 7,763,492 parameters.
blocks.zh: 平面变体是nU-Net默认配置的平面演化型U-Net [30, 31], 完全相同,只是剩余添加和1×1 1 时 1 跳过投影被删除, 参数为 7,763,492 .

blocks.en: 3.4.3 Shared training recipe
blocks.zh: 3.4.3 国家 共享培训方法

blocks.en: Both follow the nnU-Net recipe [ 30 ] : stochastic gradient descent with momentum 0.99 and Nesterov acceleration, a polynomial schedule, weight decay 3e-5, aggressive augmentation, deep supervision and a combined Dice and cross-entropy objective. The augmentation policy was determined empirically, and that search is reported in Section 4.4 where it also tests whether the deficit is a configuration failure. Learning rates were searched independently for each architecture on polyp over an identical grid, selecting 3e-3 for the residual variant and 1e-3 for the plain one. In the skin domain both architectures ran at 3e-3; the plain variant’s polyp-selected rate was not additionally evaluated there. One consequence bears on Section 4.2 : the skin comparison is the more controlled of the three, both models operating at the same rate, whereas in polyp and breast each is at its own selected setting. The comparison is therefore two models each at its own best setting rather than a controlled ablation, a limitation noted in Section 5.4 along with the search having been conducted on polyp alone.
blocks.zh: 两者都遵循nU-Net配方[30]: 具有0.99和Nesterov加速度的分色梯度下降,一个多号表,重量衰减3e-5,进取增强,深度监督以及一个综合的Dice和跨热带目标. 扩充政策是按经验确定的,第4.4节报告了搜索情况,其中还测试赤字是否为配置故障。 在一个相同的网格上独立搜索了每个结构的学习率,选择了3e-3的剩余变体和1e-3的平原变体。 在皮肤领域,两种建筑都运行在3e-3;平原变体的多p选择率在那里没有得到额外的评价。 第4.2节有一个后果:皮肤比较对三种模型的控制越大,两种模型都以相同的速度运作,而在多肽和乳房中,每种模型都处于自己选定的环境。 因此,这种比较是两个模式,每个模式在最佳情况下都是最佳的,而不是受控制的停产,第5.4节指出了这一局限性,同时仅对多肽进行了搜索。

blocks.en: 3.5 Training protocol and model selection
blocks.zh: 3.5 培训协议和模式选择

blocks.en: DINOv2 operates on fourteen-pixel patches, so resolutions are multiples of fourteen: 224 × 224 224{\times}224 at batch size 16 for polyp and breast, and 392 × 392 392{\times}392 at batch size 8 for skin, where dermoscopy boundaries are fine relative to the field of view. The task-specific models in skin run at 384 × 384 384{\times}384 , because 392 is not divisible by the cumulative downsampling factor of their encoder. The data-size sweep of Section 4.4 was run at 224 across all skin fractions to keep cost tractable, so those figures sit at a different operating point and are compared only against themselves.
blocks.zh: DINOv2在十四像素补丁上运行,因此分辨率是十四的倍数:多肽和乳腺的批号为16;皮肤的批号为392×392×392×392,皮肤的批号为8,其皮肤外观边界相对视场细微. 皮肤中的任务特异性模型运行于384×384384\Times}384,因为392不能被其编码器的累积下采样因子分散. 第4.4节的数据尺寸扫描以224的速度在所有皮肤部分进行,以保持成本可循性,因此这些数字处于不同的操作点,只能与自己进行比较。

blocks.en: Adaptation strategies converge within tens of epochs, whereas task-specific models require an order of magnitude more; within any single comparison the budget is identical, so no configuration is advantaged by training duration. Task-specific models were trained for 300 epochs in polyp and breast and 100 in skin (Table 4 ). Adaptation ran at two budgets, 20 epochs for the core comparison and 40 for the capacity analyses following the budget control of Section 4.5 , and figures from the two are never combined within a domain. In the data-size sweep, budgets were scaled inversely with subset size so each fraction received approximately equal optimiser steps, without which the deficit would confound data volume with training duration.
blocks.zh: 适应战略在数十个世纪内趋同,而针对具体任务的模型则需要更多数量级;在任何单一的比较中,预算是相同的,因此培训时间不有利于配置。 为300个多胞胎和乳房以及100个皮肤地区培训了具体任务模式(表4)。 适应工作有两个预算,20个核心比较时代和40个能力分析时期,根据第4.5节的预算控制,两者的数字从未在一个领域合并。 在数据大小扫描中,预算用子集大小反向缩放,因此,每一部分都得到大致相同的选择步骤,没有这些步骤,赤字就会使数据量与培训时间相混淆。

blocks.en: Table 4: Epoch budgets, matched within every comparison but not across domains.
blocks.zh: 表4:Epoch预算,在每项比较中都对应,但不同领域没有对应。

blocks.en: The programme these budgets describe is substantial. Each of the three domains carries seven adaptation configurations on the capacity axis, two task-specific architectures, three or four training-set fractions, and a learning-rate search over four values for BitFit, with the same search run in polyp for each of the two task-specific models; the core comparison between LoRA and full fine-tuning is run at three seeds and at two ranks, and the capacity axis at two budgets. Running few methods at many operating points, which Section 2.5 identifies as the trade-off this study makes, is what accounts for that count, and it is also what makes Section 4.6 possible.
blocks.zh: 这些预算所述的方案是实质性的。 3个域中每个域在容量轴上搭载7个适应配置,2个任务特定架构,3个或4个训练集分,BitFit在4个值上进行学习率搜索,两个任务特定模型中每个都用多普进行相同的搜索;LORA和全微调的核心比较在3个种子和2个排位上运行,能力轴在2个预算上运行. 在许多操作点使用很少的方法,而第2.5节将这种方法确定为本研究报告的权衡结果,这就是计算的原因,也是使第4.6节成为可能的原因。

blocks.en: Checkpoints, learning rates, ranks and configurations were all selected on in-domain validation DSC, and no out-of-distribution test set influenced any selection decision at any stage. This is emphasised because it is load-bearing: a recurring observation is that the configuration optimal in domain is not the one optimal out of distribution, and that carries weight only if selection was genuinely blind to those sets.
blocks.zh: 检查点,学习率,排位和配置均选在域内验证DSC上,没有分配外测试集在任何阶段都会影响任何选择决定. 之所以强调这一点,是因为它具有负载性:一种反复出现的观察是,域内最佳配置不是分配的最佳配置,只有在选择真正无视这些组合时才具有重量。

blocks.en: 3.6 Reproducibility, the measurement floor and evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.6 可复制性、测量底线和评价

blocks.en: All experiments used PyTorch [ 49 ] , HuggingFace Transformers [ 64 ] and the PEFT library, with mixed precision [ 44 ] , on NVIDIA L4 and A100 GPUs, with checkpoints written to persistent storage so that interrupted sessions could resume without retraining. Seed 42 was used throughout, with 123 and 2024 added for the core comparison of LoRA against full fine-tuning. BitFit and the plain U-Net were run at seed 42 only and are reported as single-seed signal rather than multi-seed evidence, and the two terms are used with that distinction throughout.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都使用PyTorch [49],HuggingFace Transformers [64] 和 PEFT 库,在NVIDIA L4和A100 GPU上混合精确度[44],有检查站写成持续存储,这样中断的会话就可以在不进行再培训的情况下恢复. 种子42一直被使用,123和2024增加了LORA与全微调的核心比较. BitFit和Plain U-Net只在42种子运行,被报告为单一种子信号而不是多种子证据,这两个术语在使用时始终有这种区别。

blocks.en: Seeding does not make these runs deterministic. Seeding covered the main process only, leaving the dataloader workers’ augmentation sequence non-deterministic, and cuDNN determinism was not enforced, so two runs at an identical seed may diverge. This was observed directly: a repeated BitFit polyp run differed by up to 0.013 DSC out of distribution and 0.004 on validation. Determinism was not enforced partway through because that would have made later runs non-comparable with earlier ones. Two skin analyses initially contained an evaluation error; both were re-evaluated from the same checkpoints, and all figures reported here are the corrected ones.
blocks.zh: 播种不会决定这些运行。 种子只覆盖了主要过程,使数据载体工人的增强序列不具有决定力,而cuDNN决定力没有强制实施,因此在同一个种子中两次运行可能会有差异。 这一点被直接观察到:重复的BitFit polyp运行在发行量上的差异高达0.013 DSC,在验证时的差异高达0.004. 最终决定主义没有被部分地执行,因为这样以后就与先前的决定不可相比。 两次皮肤分析最初都包含一个评价错误;两次评估都是从同一检查站重新评估的,这里报告的所有数字都是经更正的数字。

blocks.en: That variation is adopted as a measurement floor, and its scope requires precise statement because it does not apply uniformly. The band was derived from the difference between two single runs and therefore bounds point comparisons: where a configuration is represented by one number, a difference below 0.013 DSC cannot be distinguished from run-to-run variation and is not interpreted, irrespective of sign. This governs the capacity axis, both task-specific architectures, the data-size sweep and every learning-rate search. It is a reference drawn from one repeated configuration rather than a measured bound for every experiment.
blocks.zh: 这种变化被作为衡量底线,其范围需要精确说明,因为它没有统一适用。 频段来源于两个单跑的区别,因此是界限点比较:如果一个配置以一个数字为代表,那么低于0.013 DSC的区别不能与运行到运行的变异区分开来,而且无论符号如何,都不会被解释. 这规范了能力轴,既包括任务特定架构,数据大小扫描,也包括每个学习率搜索. 这是从一个重复的配置中引用的参考,而不是每个实验的量度约束.

blocks.en: It does not govern the paired significance tests of Section 4.5 , which measure a different quantity. The Wilcoxon signed-rank test applied to seed-averaged per-image vectors assesses not the magnitude of a difference but its consistency across images: a small difference holding in the same direction on most images is significant, while a larger one varying erratically is not. The polyp comparison demonstrates this within a single table, where CVC-ColonDB shows a difference of + 0.0022 +0.0022 with the lowest p p -value of the five at 0.0001, while ETIS shows the largest at + 0.0130 +0.0130 and is not significant at p = 0.1191 p=0.1191 . Reporting either criterion alone would misdescribe the comparison, so multi-seed results are reported by direction and p p -value with magnitude given but not used as a threshold, and single-run comparisons against the band and never with a p p -value. Because the signed-rank statistic is computed on the ranks of the absolute per-image differences, magnitude enters the test through those ranks; and because images rather than seeds are the unit of pairing, the test does not directly assess variation across seeds.
blocks.zh: 它不适用于第4.5节的配对意义测试,该节衡量的数量不同。 Wilcoxon的签名排名测试适用于种子平均成像矢量,它评估的不是差异的大小,而是图像之间的一致性:在大多数图像上保持相同方向的微小差异是显著的,而较大的差异则变化不定。 聚p比较在单表内显示这一点,其中CVC-CoronDB显示的差值为+0.0022+0.0022,最低p值为5,为0.0001,而ETIS显示的最大值为+0.0130+0.0130,在p=0.1191p=0.1191时并不显著. 单是报告任一标准就会错误地描述比较,因此,多种子结果按方向和p-值报告,其数值为给定的阈值,但没有用作阈值,单跑比较与波段比较,从不使用p-值。 由于签名排名统计是按绝对成像差异的等级计算的,所以量通过这些等级进入测试;由于图像而不是种子是配对的单位,测试并不直接评估不同种子的差异.

blocks.en: Segmentation quality is reported with six metrics: the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) and intersection over union (IoU) for overlap; sensitivity and precision, which separate a missed lesion from over-segmentation; and, for the boundary, two spatial-distance metrics in the taxonomy of Taha and Hanbury [56] , the 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95), taken over the boundary distances in both directions, and the average symmetric surface distance (ASSD), the mean of the two directed mean boundary distances, together with the normalised surface Dice (NSD) [ 47 ] , the fraction of boundary points of each mask lying within a tolerance of the other’s boundary. All are accumulated per image rather than pooled, since pooling weights each image by its lesion area; per-image accumulation also yields a vector rather than a scalar, which is what makes significance testing possible. Where multiple seeds are available, comparisons are tested by Wilcoxon signed-rank [ 63 ] per test set, preferred to a paired t t -test because per-image DSC distributions are strongly left-skewed, and to a Mann–Whitney test because it retains the pairing. Single-seed results are not tested, since a p p -value on one run would characterise variation across images rather than across runs.
blocks.zh: 报告分层质量时有6个衡量标准:Dice相似系数(DSC)和结合(IoU)上的交叉系数;灵敏度和精确度,将错失的损伤与过度分层区分开来;关于边界,Taha和Hanbury分类法中的两个空间-距离测量标准(56),95百分位的Husdorff距离(HD95)占据了两个方向的边界距离,平均对称的表面距离(ASSD),两个定向平均边界距离的平均值,加上正常化的表面分层(NSD)[47],每个遮罩的分点都位于其他边界的容忍度范围内。 所有图像都是累积的,而不是集合的,因为每个图像按其损伤区域集中加权;每个图像的累积也产生一个矢量而不是一个标量,这就是使得意义测试成为可能的原因. 在有多种种子的情况下,比较会通过威尔科克森签名排名的每套测试进行测试[63],优于一个对齐的 t - t - 测试,因为每个图像的DSC分布都是强烈的左侧扭曲,而曼-Whitney测试则因其保留配对. 未测试单一种子结果,因为一次运行的p-值将说明不同图像而不是不同运行的特性。

blocks.en: Distances are measured in pixels at the resolution each model was evaluated at, because most of the datasets do not record physical pixel spacing. That resolution differs between domains, and within skin between the adapted and the task-specific models (Section 3.5 ), so HD95 and ASSD are also reported divided by the image diagonal; only the normalised values are compared across resolutions, and pixel values only within one. The NSD tolerance is defined as a fixed fraction of the image width, 2/224, which is 2 pixels at 224, 3.4 at 384 and 3.5 at 392; results at twice that tolerance are given in Table 8 . Where exactly one of the two masks is empty, HD95 and ASSD are set to the image diagonal at that resolution and NSD to zero, and the number of such images is reported together with the boundary metrics over the images where both masks are non-empty. A prediction that is empty when a lesion is present is counted as precision zero. No reference mask was empty at the evaluated resolution in any test set, so the case of an empty reference never arose.
blocks.zh: 距离用分辨率的像素来测量,因为大多数数据集没有记录物理像素间距,所以每个模型都得到了评价. 该分辨率在域之间不同,在外观内在适应模型和任务特定模型之间不同(第3.5节),因此HD95和ASSD也被图像对角除法报告;只有常态值在分辨率之间进行比较,像素值仅在一个内. NSD容积被定义为图像宽度的固定部分,2/224,2像素为224,3.4为384,3.5为392;结果为容积的两倍于表8. 如果两个面具中有一个是空的,则HD95和ASSD被设定为该分辨率的图像对角,NDSD被设定为零,而这种图像的数量与两个面具均为非空的图像的边界测量值一起报告。 出现损伤时为空的预测值被计算为精度零. 在任何测试集中,评价的解析度中没有任何引用掩码是空的,因此空引用的情况从未出现.

blocks.en: DSC was the only criterion used for selection. The other five metrics were computed afterwards from the same checkpoints, and no model or configuration choice depends on them. Before they were computed, the per-image DSC of every checkpoint was recomputed and compared with the corresponding values reported in this paper, 130 checks in all across the tables of this paper; every value agreed to within 0.001, the largest deviation being 0.0007.
blocks.zh: DSC是选择的唯一标准。 其他五个衡量标准随后从同一个检查站计算,没有模式或配置选择取决于这些检查站。 在计算之前,重新计算了每个检查站的每个图像DSC,并与本文件中报告的相应数值进行比较,本文件各表的130个检查;在0.001范围内商定的每个数值,最大偏差为0.0007。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 In-domain parity, out-of-distribution deficit
blocks.zh: 4.1 域内均等、分配外赤字

blocks.en: This section reports the direct comparison, using the strongest configuration of each approach: DINOv2 with LoRA at rank 32, selected on in-domain validation, against the two task-specific architectures (Table 5 ). DSC is discussed first, as the metric every selection decision used; the other five metrics follow.
blocks.zh: 本节报告直接比较情况,采用每种方法的最强配置:DINov2与LORA在域内验证时选定的第32级,与两个任务特定架构相对应(表5)。 首先讨论DSC,因为每个选择决定都采用衡量标准;其他五个衡量标准也采用。

(a) In-domain DSC; (b)–(d) out-of-distribution DSC, HD95 divided by the image diagonal (lower is better) and NSD at 2/224 of the image width. Skin has no in-domain test set. blocks.en: The two regimes give opposite answers. In domain, adaptation confers no advantage. Averaged over the two in-domain polyp sets the plain U-Net reaches 0.8803 against 0.8780, a difference well below the 0.013 measurement floor (Section 3.6 ), and the residual variant is behind by − 0.006 -0.006 , likewise within it; in breast both task-specific models are ahead on a validation split that also served for early stopping, so this result is indicative rather than conclusive. Within the distribution a model was trained on, a conventional U-Net trained from random initialisation therefore matches an adapted DINOv2, at roughly a third of the parameters and, as Section 4.4 shows, in breast with as few as 119 training images.
blocks.zh: 两个政权给出了相反的答案. 在域内,适应没有优势。 平均而言,在两个域内设置的平原U-Net达到0.8803,而0.8780, 差异远低于0.013的测量底线(第3.6节),剩余变体落后于−0.006-0.06,同样在它内部;在乳房中,两种特定任务的模式都处于验证分拆的前面,这种分拆也有利于及早停止,因此这一结果只是指示性的而不是结论性的。 因此,在分发过程中,对一个模型进行了培训,通过随机初始化培训的常规U-Net将一个经过调整的DINOv2与大约三分之一的参数相匹配,并且如第4.4节所示,胸腔中只有119个培训图像。

blocks.en: Out of distribution the picture reverses on all eight sets, under both architectures, without exception (Fig. 4 ; per-set deficits in Table 7 ). But the uniformity of the sign should not obscure the variation in magnitude: the sixteen deficits range from − 0.008 -0.008 (PH2, plain U-Net) to − 0.107 -0.107 (BUS-UCLM, ResU-Net), and two fall within the floor, both in skin. Skin is therefore not an exception in direction but close to one in magnitude. Two considerations bear on this: it has by far the largest training set, and two of its three test sets originate from the same archive as the training data, representing a milder shift. PH2, the one genuinely independent skin source, shows the smallest deficit of the three under the plain U-Net, which does not support the second explanation. Section 4.4 addresses the first.
blocks.zh: 在分发中,所有八套图象都毫无例外地在两种结构下出现反向(图4;表7中的每套赤字)。 但标志的统一性不应掩盖数量上的差异:16个赤字从−0.008-0.008(PH2,平原U-Net)到−0.107-0.107(BUS-UCLM,ResU-Net),两个都落在地板上,都是皮肤上的. 因此,皮肤在方向上并非例外,在数量上接近于例外。 有两个考虑对此有影响:它拥有迄今为止最大的一套培训,其三套测试中有两套来自与培训数据相同的档案,代表了更温和的转变。 PH2,一个真正独立的皮肤来源,显示了平原U-Net下三个中最小的赤字,它不支持第二个解释. 第4.4节涉及第一项。

blocks.zh: 表6:在8套分配外装置上,相对于DINov2 + LORA r = 32 r{=}32的每个任务特定模型的缺陷。 负值表示任务特定模型落后;匕首标记了0.013层以下的差异.

blocks.en: Table 7: Plain U-Net minus ResU-Net by test set, all domains, single seed. Positive values favour the plain architecture; a dagger marks differences below the floor.
blocks.zh: 表7:按测试集,所有域,单一种子划分的普通U-Net减去ResU-Net. 正面的数值有利于平面建筑;一匕首标志着地板下方的差异.

blocks.en: The other metrics agree with DSC out of distribution except at the finest scale of the boundary. DINOv2 is best on all eight out-of-distribution sets in IoU, sensitivity and HD95, and on seven in precision and ASSD; the exceptions are precision on ISIC 2016*, and ASSD on CVC-ColonDB, where the maximum distance assigned to its empty predictions (Section 4.3 ) outweighs its advantage on the remaining images. NSD at the 2/224 tolerance does not follow: a task-specific model leads on four of the eight sets, all four evaluated at 224 pixels, and in domain both task-specific models lead DINOv2 on all three in-domain sets, by up to 0.14 on CVC-ClinicDB. Fig. 4 summarises these quantities by domain and regime, and Fig. 5 shows the per-image distributions behind the out-of-distribution means. The advantage is a shift of the distribution rather than a uniform gain: DINOv2 has the higher DSC on between 55 and 62 per cent of out-of-distribution images, depending on domain and comparator, and every model retains a long lower tail on CVC-ColonDB, ETIS and both breast sets. Distances in pixels, NSD at the secondary tolerance and the boundary metrics over non-empty predictions are given in Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 其他的度量衡与DSC一致,除边界最优的度量衡外,没有分布. DINOv2在IoU,灵敏度和HD95的所有8个分布外集上以及7个精度和ASSD上都是最好的;在国际标准行业分类2016* 和CVC-CoronDB上,ASD的精度是例外的,其中分配给其空预测的最大距离(第4.3节)大于其在剩余图像上的优势. 2224容忍度的NSD不遵循:一个任务特定模式领先于八套中的四套,全部四套均以224像素评价,在域内两个任务特定模式都领先于三套内置的DINOv2,在CVC-ClinicDB上最高为0.14. 图4按域和制度概括了这些数量,图5显示了分散方式背后的逐象分布. 优点是分布的转变而不是统一收益:DINov2根据域和参照物的不同,在55%至62%的分布外图像上,DSC较高,每个模型在CVC-CoronDB,ETIS和两个乳房套上都保留了较长的下尾. 以像素表示的距离、二级容忍度的NSD以及非空预测的边界指标见表8。

The last three columns repeat HD95, ASSD (divided by the image diagonal) and NSD at 2/224 over the images on which the model’s prediction is not empty, so that the penalty assigned to empty predictions is visible as the difference from Table 5 . Skin DINOv2 values are three-seed means of per-image values; an image counts as empty for it when its seed-averaged empty indicator is at least 0.5.

Boxes span the interquartile range with the median in white; whiskers extend to 1.5 times the interquartile range; diamonds mark the mean. An empty prediction scores DSC 0 and HD95 1. Models and budgets as in Table 5 ; skin DINOv2 values are per-image means over three seeds.

blocks.en: 4.2 The deficit is not architectural
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 亏本不是建筑

blocks.en: Section 4.1 rests on an assumption not yet examined: that the task-specific models are competently configured. If they are not, the deficits measure the quality of the implementation rather than any property of task-specific training.
blocks.zh: 第4.1节所依据的假设尚未审查:具体任务模式的配置是适当的。 如果不是,则缺陷衡量执行质量,而不是具体任务培训的任何财产。

blocks.en: The two architectures agree. They differ architecturally only in the residual connection, applied in both encoder and decoder, and are otherwise identical in widths, downsampling, normalisation, activation, deep supervision and recipe, each at its own selected learning rate. The deficit is negative in all sixteen comparisons: two models at different points on the task-specific design space, tuned independently, place the same eight sets on the same side.
blocks.zh: 两种建筑都同意. 它们仅在剩余连接上存在建筑差异,既适用于编码器,也适用于解码器,在宽度,下采样,正常化,激活,深层监管和配方方面则完全相同,各自按照自己选定的学习速度进行. 在所有16个比较中,赤字都是负数:在任务特定设计空间的不同点上的两个模型独立调制,将相同的8套放在同一边.

blocks.en: A secondary result runs against expectation. The plain U-Net is ahead of the residual variant on seven of the eight out-of-distribution sets and behind on one, ISIC 2017* by 0.002, and five differences exceed the floor (Table 7 ). Under the conditions here, two-dimensional and binary with 479 to 2,075 training images, the residual variant trained under the nnU-Net recipe therefore did not outperform its plain counterpart, and out of distribution it is the weaker of the two. Two qualifications apply: the comparison is single-seed, so it rests on the five differences clearing the floor, and in polyp and breast the architectures ran at different learning rates, so part of the difference there may originate in the optimiser rather than the residual connection. Skin is the exception and is therefore the most informative of the three: both architectures ran at 3e-3, making that comparison a single-variable ablation, and the plain variant is ahead on two of its three test sets. What the comparison establishes is that no reasonable task-specific configuration closes the gap.
blocks.zh: 次级结果与预期不符。 平原U-Net在8套分配外的7套中领先剩余变体,在1套中落后于国际标准行业分类2017年* 0.02,5种差异超过下限(表7)。 在此条件下,二维和二进制有479至2 075个训练图像,因此,在nU-Net配方下培训的剩余变体没有超过其平庸的对应体,在分发中它是两者中最弱的。 两种资格适用:比较是单种的,所以它依赖于清理地板的五种差异,在多肽和乳房中,建筑运行的学习速度不同,所以其中的部分差异可能源于opimiser而不是剩余连接. 皮肤是例外,因此是三部曲中信息最丰富的:两部建筑运行于3e-3,使得这种比较是单变的斜拉片,平面变体在其三部测试集中的两部都领先. 比较确定的是,没有合理的具体任务配置可以弥合差距。

blocks.en: The internal comparison shows the deficit does not depend on the architecture chosen; it does not show either is strong in absolute terms. Because polyp follows the protocol of Fan et al. [21] , published scores are directly comparable in setup (Table 9 ).
blocks.zh: 内部比较显示,赤字并不取决于所选择的架构;它也没有显示绝对值的强度。 因为polyp遵循了Fan等人的协议. [21],公布的分数在设置中直接可比(表9 ).

blocks.en: Table 9: Comparison with published results (DSC) on the three out-of-distribution polyp sets under the PraNet protocol [ 21 ] . Rows from this work are single-seed. U-Net, U-Net++, ACSNet, MSEG and Polyp-PVT scores are as reported by Dong et al. [16] ; SAM-Mamba scores are from Dutta et al. [18] . Citations in the model column identify the original methods.

blocks.en: The baselines exceed the published U-Net by 0.226 on CVC-ColonDB and 0.234 on ETIS for the plain variant, and both are ahead of ACSNet on CVC-ColonDB. blocks.en: Specialised polyp architectures published since 2023 exceed every model here, by 0.084 on CVC-ColonDB in the case of SAM-Mamba. This is expected: those architectures pair large pretrained encoders with multi-scale attention decoders developed for polyp segmentation, whereas the adapted model carries a 385-parameter linear decoder, chosen so that the adaptation axis measures how much the encoder must change rather than how much a decoder can compensate (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 2023年起出版的专用多普架构超过了这里的每个模型,在SAM-Mamba的情况下,CVC-ColonDB上增加了0.084. 预期是这样:这些架构配对了大型预先训练的编码器,并配对了为多肽分解而开发的多尺度注意力解码器,而经过改造的模型则搭载了385参数的线性解码器,选择了这种解码器,使适应轴测量编码器必须改变多少,而不是解码器能够补偿多少(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: The comparison made here is between two training paradigms under one controlled protocol, not a claim to the state of the art. What Table 9 establishes is the narrower point the comparison of Section 4.1 requires: the task-specific comparator is competitive with the published U-Net family it represents, so the deficit is not an artefact of a weak baseline.
blocks.zh: 这里所作的比较是在一个控制协议下的两个训练范式之间,而不是对最新技术的要求. 表9确定的是第4.1节的比较需要的较窄的一点:具体任务的参照国与它所代表的已公布的U-Net家族具有竞争力,因此赤字不是薄弱基线的动词。

blocks.en: 4.3 Failure modes, lesion size and boundary quality
blocks.zh: 4.3 故障模式、损伤大小和边界质量

blocks.en: Averages conceal how a model fails. Table 10 counts the images on which a model predicts no lesion at all, although every reference mask in every test set contains one. The plain U-Net never does so, and the residual variant on four polyp images. DINOv2 at the selected configuration misses 13 polyp images entirely, ten of them in CVC-ColonDB, and two breast images; elsewhere on the capacity axis the count is higher, between 25 and 40 of the 380 CVC-ColonDB images for every configuration other than LoRA at rank 32, and it rises steeply as training data shrink, to 58 CVC-ColonDB and 38 ETIS images at 10 per cent of the polyp data, against one image for the residual U-Net trained on the same subset. The missed polyps are small: the 94 CVC-ColonDB and ETIS images on which some configuration of the capacity axis predicts nothing have a median lesion area of 0.86 per cent of the image, 64 per cent of them fall in the smallest tercile of Table 11 , and on them the plain U-Net reaches a mean DSC of 0.37. Skin, whose lesions occupy a large fraction of the image, has at most one empty prediction per configuration. Complete failure is not the commoner kind overall. Counting out-of-distribution images with DSC below 0.1, DINOv2 has 48 in polyp against 54 and 69 for the plain and residual U-Nets, and 31 in breast against 57 and 60. The adapted model therefore fails less often, but when it fails on a small lesion it tends to miss the lesion altogether, where a task-specific model produces a partial segmentation.

blocks.en: Sensitivity and precision separate the remaining errors. Averaged over each domain’s out-of-distribution sets, the DSC advantage of DINOv2 over the plain U-Net comes mainly from precision in polyp and breast, + 0.047 +0.047 and + 0.084 +0.084 against + 0.011 +0.011 and + 0.047 +0.047 in sensitivity, and mainly from sensitivity in skin, + 0.025 +0.025 against + 0.007 +0.007 . Out of distribution, then, the task-specific models more often extend into tissue that is not lesion, rather than more often missing lesion tissue.

blocks.en: The boundary results suggest an explanation in terms of resolution. DINOv2 represents a 224-pixel image as a 16 × 16 16{\times}16 grid of patch embeddings, which the linear decoder upsamples bilinearly (Section 3.3 ), so its boundary can be no finer than that grid allows, whereas the U-Nets predict at full resolution. Skin, at 392 pixels, gives a 28 × 28 28{\times}28 grid, and there DINOv2 leads in NSD on all three sets. Skin also allows a comparison within one domain, because its data-size sweep was run at 224 pixels (Table 12 ). At 224 pixels the residual U-Net leads in NSD at the 2/224 tolerance on all three skin sets while DINOv2 still leads in DSC and HD95; at the native resolutions DINOv2 leads in all of them. Within a domain, the direction of the fine-boundary comparison therefore changes with resolution, which is consistent with the patch grid limiting boundary precision. It is not an isolated test: the two pairs also differ in training budget, and at the lower data fractions of the same sweep the NSD comparison is mixed. The empty predictions on small polyps fit the same account, a lesion of one per cent of a 224-pixel image covering between two and three of its 256 patches, but this was not tested directly.
blocks.zh: 边界结果表明对分辨率的解释。 DINOv2代表一个224像素的图像,作为16×16 16×Times}16个网格的补丁嵌入,线性解码器双线性上标(第3.3节),因此其边界不能比网格允许的更细,而U-Nets则以全分辨率预测. Skin, at 392 像素, 给出一个 28× 28 28 \ tims} 28 格格, 并且有 DINOv2 线索在 NSD 在全部三套上. 皮肤还允许在一个域内进行比较,因为其数据大小的扫描以224像素运行(表12 ). 在224像素时,其余的U-Net在NSD中领先于所有三套皮肤的2/224容积,而DINov2仍然领先于DSC和HD95;在原生分辨率DINov2中领先于所有三套皮肤. 因此,在一个域内,细边界比较的方向与分辨率有所变化,这与限制边界精度的补丁网格一致。 这不是一个孤立的测试:两对在培训预算方面也不同,在同一个扫描的较低数据分数中,ND比较是混合的. 对小聚体的空预测吻合同一个账户,一个覆盖其256个补丁中的2至3个的224像素图像的1%的损伤,但没有直接测试.

blocks.en: 4.4 More data closes the in-domain gap but not the out-of-distribution one
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 更多的数据缩小了域内的差距,但不是分配外的差距

blocks.en: Two explanations were left open for the variation in deficit magnitude: the domains differ in training-set size, and in the severity of the shift their test sets represent. This section addresses the first. Each domain was retrained at 25 and 50 per cent of its training set, and polyp additionally at 10 per cent, with source, architecture, evaluation and augmentation fixed, and budgets scaled inversely with subset size, which isolates data volume from modality and task difficulty as the cross-domain comparison cannot.
blocks.zh: 对于赤字幅度的变化,有两个解释没有定论:各域在培训设置的规模上有所不同,其测试组代表的转移程度也不同。 本节论述第一部分。 每个领域均按其培训组合的25%和50%重新培训,再按10%再培训,并固定源、结构、评价和增强,预算以子集规模反向缩减,从而将数据量与模式和任务困难隔离开来,因为跨领域比较是无法做到的。

blocks.en: The cross-domain figures invite a straightforward reading: ordered by training-set size and by out-of-distribution deficit the domains fall in inverse order, so the deficit appears to shrink as data grows. That reading is incorrect, since the domains differ in modality, lesion appearance, annotation protocol and test-set provenance, any of which could produce the same ordering.
blocks.zh: 跨域数字请人们直截了当地阅读:根据培训设置的大小和分配外的不足来排序,域位依反序下降,因此随着数据的增长,赤字似乎在缩小。 这种读法是不正确的,因为字段在模式、损伤外观、注释协议和测试设定的出处上各不相同,其中任何一个都可能产生相同的顺序。
