blocks.en: Comparing points of equal size across domains, as Fig. 7 shows, contradicts the confounded reading directly. At 518 images skin shows − 0.013 -0.013 , at the boundary of the floor, while at 652 images, twenty-six per cent more data, polyp shows − 0.132 -0.132 , ten times larger. The relationship does not merely weaken across domains; it reverses. Within domains it does hold, falling monotonically in polyp and less regularly in breast, and remaining indistinguishable from zero in skin at every fraction. The correct statement is conditional: within a domain more data reduces the deficit; across domains data volume does not predict it.
blocks.zh: 如图7所示,对各域大小相同的点进行比较,直接与令人困惑的读数相矛盾。 在518张图像的外观显示−0.013 - 0.013,在地板的边界上,而在652张图像上,数据增加了26%,polyp显示−0.132 - 0.132,大十倍。 这种关系不仅在不同领域之间有所削弱,而且逆转。 在它确实拥有的域内,单声道在多肽中下降,在乳房中下降的频率较低,在每一分量的皮肤中与零相差无几。 正确的语句是有条件的:在一个域内,更多的数据可以减少赤字;跨域的数据量并不预测.

blocks.en: The in-domain column tells a different story, and the contrast is the substantive finding of this section. Three of the seven configurations with an in-domain measurement fall within the floor, polyp at its full training set, and breast at 119 and 239 images, and at 479 images the task-specific model in breast is ahead by + 0.021 +0.021 , a margin that clears it on the 54-image validation split. Only polyp requires its full set to reach parity, and even at a quarter of its data the in-domain gap is − 0.050 -0.050 against − 0.135 -0.135 out of distribution on the same models. The plain U-Net reproduces this, its gaps moving from − 0.034 -0.034 and − 0.121 -0.121 at 326 images to + 0.002 +0.002 and − 0.041 -0.041 at 1,305, so the behaviour is not specific to one model; the 326-image run stopped at epoch 367 of its 1,200-epoch budget, so its deficit is not a training artefact. Stated directly: a task-specific model reaches parity on data from the training distribution using, in breast, a fraction of the available data, and does not reach it on data from a different source using all of it.
blocks.zh: 域内栏目讲述了不同的故事,对比的是本节的实质性发现. 有内测的7个配置中,有3个属于地层,多肽在全训练集,乳房在119和239的图像,在479的图像中,乳房中的任务特异性模型领先于+0.021+0.021,这个比值在54-图像验证分裂上可以清除. 只有聚p要求其全集达到对等,即使在其四分之一的数据中,域内差距为−0.050-0.50,而同一模型的分布为−0.135-0.135。 平原的U-Net复制了这一点,它的缺口从−0.034-0.34和−0.121-0.121在326的图像上转移到+0.002+0.002和−0.041-0.041在1,305的图像上,因此行为不特指一种模式;326-图像运行在其1,200个时代预算的367号时停止,因此其赤字不是训练用蒿. 直接说明:针对特定任务的模型在培训分布数据上,使用一部分可用数据,在乳房中达到对等,在使用全部数据的不同来源数据上没有达到对等.

blocks.en: Data volume is one candidate explanation for the out-of-distribution deficit; regularisation is another, since a model trained on a small dataset might be overfitting in a way a better-configured version would not. A configuration search on polyp at 326 images, in runs separate from those in Table 14 , tested this (Table 14 ). Reducing capacity to a quarter of the parameters hurt on both regimes, which argues against overfitting as the explanation; dropout hurt; heavier weight decay helped modestly, by + 0.017 +0.017 out of distribution; and aggressive augmentation was the clear winner at + 0.057 +0.057 and was adopted for all subsequent task-specific runs. None of the five closed the gap: the best remains 0.103 behind the adapted model trained on the same 326 images.
blocks.zh: 数据量是分配不足的一个可选解释;规范化是另一个解释,因为一个在小数据集上受过培训的模型可能过于适合一个配置较好的版本。 在326张图像上进行配置搜索,与表14中的图像分开运行。 将能力降低到四分之一的参数对两种制度都造成伤害,因为这两种制度都反对因解释而过于适应;辍学受伤;重量变弱程度较轻,导致分配量减少0.017+0.017;积极增强是明显赢家,在0.057+0.057,并被采纳用于随后所有具体任务。 五个都无法弥合差距:最好的仍然是在经过同样326个图像培训的经过改造的模型后面的0.103。

blocks.en: The trend holds in the distance metric and changes character at the boundary (Table 15 ). In polyp the out-of-distribution HD95 favours adaptation at every fraction, while the out-of-distribution NSD gap shrinks from − 0.175 -0.175 at 10 per cent to − 0.011 -0.011 at the full set, and in domain NSD favours the residual U-Net from 50 per cent upward, by up to + 0.079 +0.079 . In breast the out-of-distribution NSD gap stays within 0.02 of zero at every fraction, so there the out-of-distribution advantage of adaptation lies in locating the lesion rather than in tracing its boundary.
blocks.zh: 趋势是距离度量和边界变化特征(表15)。 在多分配法中,分配外的HD95有利于每个分量的适应,而分配外的NSD差距则从全套的−0.175-0.175,10%缩小到−0.011-0.011,在域NSD有利于剩余U-Net,从50%向上,最高为+0.079+0.079。 在乳房中,离散的NSD差距在每分数的0.02以内保持0,因此适应的离散优势在于确定病情的位置而不是追踪其边界.

blocks.en: Table 15: Data-size sweep in three metrics: ResU-Net minus DINOv2 + LoRA r = 32 r{=}32 on the identical subset, averaged over each domain’s in-domain and out-of-distribution sets (DSC as in Table 14 ). Positive DSC and NSD gaps and negative HD95 gaps favour training from scratch. Skin at 224 px at every fraction; the 100% rows of polyp and breast are the models of Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 表15: 数据大小扫描,分三个指标: ResU-Net 减去 DINOv2 + LORA r = 32 r {=}32 在相同的子集上,平均为每个域的域内和区外分布(DSC如表14). 积极的DSC和NSD差距和负面的HD95差距有利于从头开始的培训. 皮肤在224px的每个分数;多肽和乳房的100%行是表5的模型.

blocks.en: Two conclusions follow, pointing in different directions. Adapting a foundation model confers no advantage in fitting the training distribution once enough data is available, which polyp reaches only at its full set; below that point adaptation does help in domain, by 0.101 at 130 polyp images, 0.050 at 326 and 0.042 at 652, while in breast the scores are already close at 119 images, the smallest subset reported, though that comparison rests on the validation split rather than a held-out test set. And the variation in deficit magnitude across domains is not explained by training-set size, so whatever distinguishes the domains is a property of the domain rather than of how much data it provides. Section 4.7 reports three attempts to identify it, none of which succeeded.
blocks.zh: 随后有两个结论,指向不同方向。 调整一个基础模型,在具备足够的数据后,就没有任何好处来适应培训的分布,而聚p只达到其全套数据;在该点下,在130个聚p图像中,0.101次,在326次,在652次中,0.050次,在0.042次,而在乳房中,分数已经接近119个图像,这是所报告的最小的子集,尽管这种比较取决于验证分拆而不是一个搁置测试集。 而不同域的赤字规模的变化并不是由训练设置的大小来解释的,所以无论区分这些域都是域的属性,而不是它所提供的数据有多少. 第4.7节报告三次试图查明,但均未成功。

blocks.en: 4.5 Adaptation capacity requirements differ by domain
blocks.zh: 4.5 适应能力要求因领域而异

blocks.en: Given that a foundation model is warranted where cross-site deployment is intended, the remaining question is how much adaptation it requires. This section reports four experiments.
blocks.zh: 鉴于在打算进行跨地点部署时有必要采用一个基础模式,剩下的问题是需要多少调整。 本节报告四项试验。

blocks.en: 4.5.1 Parameter-efficient adaptation matches full fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 4.5.1 参数高效适应匹配度

blocks.en: LoRA at rank 32 was compared against full fine-tuning in polyp across three seeds at 20 epochs, with Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on seed-averaged per-image vectors (Table 16 ). LoRA minus full fine-tuning was + 0.0058 +0.0058 on Kvasir ( p = 0.0003 p=0.0003 ), + 0.0101 +0.0101 on CVC-ClinicDB ( p = 0.0194 p=0.0194 ), + 0.0022 +0.0022 on CVC-ColonDB ( p = 0.0001 p=0.0001 ), + 0.0130 +0.0130 on ETIS ( p = 0.1191 p=0.1191 ) and + 0.0006 +0.0006 on CVC-T ( p = 0.3931 p=0.3931 ); for the last two the test records a failure to reject, not equivalence. LoRA is equal or ahead on all five, significantly on three, and full fine-tuning wins nowhere despite updating thirty-seven times as many parameters. The magnitudes are small and fall at or below the floor governing single-run comparisons, but that floor does not apply to a paired test over images whose scores are averaged across three seeds. Skin gives comparable differences, significant on two of its three sets at the same rank. This is consistent with the wider literature and is not novel; it is reported because the rest of the section depends on it. In the other metrics the comparison is not one-sided (Table 17 ). LoRA is also ahead on all five sets in IoU and NSD, significantly on three in each, and has significantly higher sensitivity on four, but its precision is significantly lower on all three out-of-distribution sets, by up to 0.049 on CVC-ColonDB: at equal or better DSC it covers more of each polyp and more of its surroundings than full fine-tuning does. LoRA at rank 32 is therefore equal or ahead in DSC, IoU and NSD, not in every metric.
blocks.zh: 将第32名的LORA比作在20世纪时对三个种子的多肽进行全面微调,威尔科克斯对种子平均成像矢量进行签名排名测试(表16)。 LoRA减全微调在Kvasir(p = 0.0003 p = 0.0003),CVC-ClinicDB(p = 0.0194 p = 0.0194),+ 0.0022+ 0.0022在CVC-ColonDB上. (p = 0.0001 p = 0.0001),在ETIS上+ 0.0130+ 0.0130 (p = 0.1191 p = 0.1191),在CVC-T上+ 0.0006+ 0.0006 (p = 0.3931 p );对于后两个测试记录显示拒绝失败,不等于. 洛拉在全部5个参数上是相等的或领先的,在3个参数上是显著的,尽管更新了37倍的参数,但完全微调却无处取胜. 大小较小,在下层或下层进行单跑比较,但该下层不适用于对三颗种子平均得分的图像进行对等测试。 皮肤给出了相似的差异,在它的三组中,有两组具有显著的相同等级. 这与较广的文献一致,不是新奇的;之所以有报道,是因为部分的其余部分都依赖于它. 在其他指标中,比较不是单方面的(表17)。 LORA在IoU和NSD的所有5套设备上也领先,在每套设备上显著高于3套,在4套设备上的灵敏度显著提高,但在所有3套外分配设备上其精度明显较低,在CVC-CoronDB上最高为0.049:在相等或较好的DSC上,它覆盖了每套设备中更多的,其周围比完全微调时要多. 因此,第32级的LORA在DSC,IoU和NSD中是相等的或领先的,而不是在每个度量中.

Values are three-seed means (seeds 42, 123 and 2024); the seed-42 LoRA r = 32 r{=}32 run alone appears in Table 24 . An asterisk marks p < 0.05 p<0.05 in a Wilcoxon signed-rank test on the seed-averaged per-image vectors (Section 3.6 ).

blocks.en: 4.5.2 The rank requirement differs by domain
blocks.zh: 4.5.2 国家 等级要求因域而异

blocks.en: Swept over ranks 4, 8, 16 and 32 under the 20-epoch protocol, the domains give three profiles. Skin gains nothing from rank beyond 4, no set moving beyond the floor and the largest change to rank 32 being + 0.005 +0.005 on ISIC 2017*; breast improves to rank 16 then plateaus; polyp continues improving at 32. Expressed as a requirement, skin needs approximately rank 4, breast 16 and polyp at least 32, a factor of eight, so no single default serves all three. One feature of the training logs qualifies this: at 20 epochs the low ranks were still improving while the high ranks had converged, so part of what is measured as capacity may be a convergence rate.
blocks.zh: 根据20世纪协议, 域名为4、8、16和32, 皮肤从4级以上没有任何增益,在2017年国际标准行业分类*上,没有超过下限的套件,第32级的最大变化是+0.005+0.005;乳房改善至16级,然后是高原;多肽在32级继续改善。 作为要求,皮肤需要大约4级,乳房16级和多肽至少32级,一个系数为8,所以没有单一的默认服务服务于所有三个. 训练记录的一个特点是,在20个世纪中,低级别仍在提高,而高级级别已经趋同,因此,根据能力衡量,其中的一部分可能是趋同率。

blocks.en: 4.5.3 The effect of the epoch budget
blocks.zh: 4.5.3 信息技术 划时代预算的影响

blocks.en: The qualification at the end of the previous section is testable, and this experiment tests it. If the low ranks were still improving at 20 epochs while the high ranks had converged, then extending the budget should shrink the measured rank effect where it reflects convergence and leave it where it reflects capacity. Polyp and breast were therefore rerun at 40 epochs with all else unchanged, and the rank effect was measured as each domain’s span at 20 epochs, rank 16 minus rank 4 in breast and rank 32 minus rank 4 in polyp (Table 18 ).
blocks.zh: 前一节结尾的合格是可测试的,这个实验测试它. 如果低级在20个世纪时仍在提高,而高级则已经趋同,那么扩大预算应缩小反映趋同的衡量等级效应,而将其留在反映能力的地方。 因此,Polyp和乳房重新运行在40个时间段,所有其他时间段没有变化,而等级效应是按每个领域在20个时间段的长度来衡量的,在乳房中排名16减4级,在聚P中排名32减4级(表18)。

blocks.en: Table 18: Effect of doubling the epoch budget on the measured rank effect. Breast rows use r = 16 − r = 4 r{=}16-r{=}4 and the polyp row r = 32 − r = 4 r{=}32-r{=}4 , in each case that domain’s span at 20 epochs. Single seed.
blocks.zh: 表18:将划时代预算增加一倍对衡量等级效应的影响。 乳房行使用r = 16 = r = 4 r = 16-r = 4 r = 4 r = 4 r = 3 = 4 r = 4 r = 4 r = 4 r – r = 4,每个域的长度为 20 ocs. 单种.

blocks.en: In breast the out-of-distribution rank effect largely dissolves. It vanishes on BrEaST, from + 0.030 +0.030 to + 0.001 +0.001 , where rank 4 comes within 0.001 of rank 16 given twice the budget, and halves on BUS-UCLM, from + 0.023 +0.023 to + 0.014 +0.014 , which sits at the edge of the floor. What appeared at 20 epochs as a requirement of rank 16 was therefore in substantial part a difference in convergence speed. In polyp it survives and grows slightly, from + 0.046 +0.046 to + 0.055 +0.055 on CVC-ColonDB. Convergence was verified rather than assumed, the rank-16 and full fine-tuning runs early-stopping at epochs 31 and 35 while the rest moved by no more than 0.001 over their final six epochs.
blocks.zh: 在乳房中,分配外的排位效应基本溶解. 它在BrEaST上消失,从+0.030+0.030到+0.001+0.001,其中第4级在给预算两倍的16级中的0.001范围内,在BUS-UCLM上消失一半,从+0.023+0.023到+0.014+0.014,位于地板边缘. 因此,20世纪作为第16级要求出现的情况在很大程度上是趋同速度的不同。 在多聚体中,它在CVC-CoronDB上存活并略有生长,从+0.046+0.046到+0.055+0.055. 16级和全面微调在31和35世纪提前进行,而其余的移动不超过0.001次,超过了最后六个世纪。

blocks.en: The in-domain measurement behaves differently within the same domain: doubling the budget leaves it almost unchanged, from + 0.040 +0.040 to + 0.038 +0.038 , while the out-of-distribution effect largely dissolves, so the two were measuring different things at 20 epochs, in-domain reflecting capacity and out-of-distribution largely reflecting optimisation progress. The difference between reporting a requirement of 16 and one of 4 in breast rests entirely on whether the experiment ran for 20 or 40 epochs. All subsequent capacity analyses in polyp and breast are therefore at 40 epochs, skin remaining at 20 to match its rank sweep, and the domain-dependence survives in weakened form.
blocks.zh: 域内测量在同一个域内表现不同:预算翻一番使其几乎保持不变,从+0.040+0.040到+0.038+0.038,而分配外效应基本溶解,因此两者在20个纪元时测量不同事物,域内反映能力,分配外主要反映优化进度. 报告乳房中16个要求和4个要求之间的区别完全取决于实验持续了20或40个世纪。 因此,所有随后在聚磷酸酯和乳房中进行的能力分析都处于40个纪元,皮肤保持在20个纪元以配合其排位扫荡,域依赖以弱化的形式生存.

blocks.en: 4.5.4 The requirement is not specific to LoRA
blocks.zh: 4.5.4 (中文(简体) ). 这项规定并非专门针对LORA

blocks.en: Rank belongs to LoRA’s mechanism, and it remains possible that what varies is how well low-rank factorisation suits each domain’s required update. BitFit tests this, having no rank parameter, intervening at bias terms throughout the encoder, and using 51,841 parameters, below LoRA at rank 4 (Table 19 , Fig. 8 ).
blocks.zh: 排名属于LORA的机理, 不同之处仍然是低排名的指数化如何适合每个域的更新。 BitFit测试了这一点,没有排名参数,在整个编码器中干预偏差术语,并使用51,841个参数,低于LORA排名4(表19,图8).

blocks.en: Table 19: Capacity axis by test set in all metrics. Polyp and breast at 40 epochs, skin at 20 to match its rank sweep, all seed 42. The skin frozen configuration is omitted: its checkpoint was trained under an earlier protocol and is not comparable. DSC values are those of the original evaluation, except on CVC-ClinicDB, which was not reported there and is recomputed. HD95 and ASSD are divided by the image diagonal (lower is better); NSD 2 and NSD 4 at 2/224 and 4/224 of the image width. BitFit’s BUSI-val value is its own selection criterion, not an independent result. (in) marks in-domain sets. Bold marks the best configuration for each test set and metric.

Solid lines: in-domain DSC (Kvasir, BUSI-val); dashed lines: mean over the domain’s out-of-distribution sets. The three panels share the vertical axis.

blocks.en: The domain ordering reproduces under BitFit. Taking BitFit minus LoRA r = 32 r{=}32 across the eight out-of-distribution sets gives − 0.001 -0.001 , − 0.008 -0.008 and − 0.004 -0.004 in skin; + 0.020 +0.020 and + 0.040 +0.040 in breast; and − 0.003 -0.003 , − 0.012 -0.012 and − 0.049 -0.049 in polyp. On seven of eight sets, 51,841 parameters match or exceed what 590,209 achieve, and the single deficit outside the floor is CVC-ColonDB. Polyp is thus the only domain where the eleven-fold larger budget buys anything, and it is the domain the rank sweep identified as requiring rank 32. Two methods differing in parameter count, in intervention site, and in whether they possess a rank parameter at all place the same domain above the others, which locates the requirement in the domain rather than in low-rank factorisation.
blocks.zh: 域名命令在BitFit下复制. 将BitFit减去LORA r = 32 r = = = 32 r == 32 横跨八套分配方式,在皮肤中给出−0.001 - 0.001、−0.008 - 0.008和−0.004 - 0.004;在乳房中给出+0.020 + 0.020和+ 0.040 + 0.040;在多肽中给出−0.003 - 0.003、−0.012 - 0.049 - 0.049。 在8套中的7套中,51,841个参数匹配或超过590,209实现的,地板外的单赤字是CVC-CoronDB. 因此,Polyp是11倍大的预算购买任何物品的唯一域,是被确定为需要第32级的等级扫码域. 两种方法在参数计数,干预站点,以及它们是否拥有排名参数时,将同一域置于其他域之上,这些域位位于域中而不是低排名的因子化中.

blocks.en: Two features of the axis are consistent where the full axis is available. The initial step carries most of the benefit: frozen to BitFit gains + 0.192 +0.192 on ETIS, + 0.133 +0.133 on CVC-ColonDB and + 0.102 +0.102 on CVC-T in polyp, and + 0.124 +0.124 and + 0.079 +0.079 in breast, and on every one the remaining step to 22.1 million is smaller than the first. This is restricted to polyp and breast, the skin frozen configuration not being comparable. And full fine-tuning does not lead: across the eight sets it is highest only on ETIS, so twenty-two million trainable parameters purchase no consistent advantage over fifty thousand, and this on the smallest DINOv2 variant, where the case for updating the whole encoder is strongest.
blocks.zh: 在有全轴的地方,轴线的两个特征是一致的. 初始步骤携带了大部分好处:在ETIS上冷冻到BitFit增益+0.192+0.192,在CVC-CoronDB上冷冻到0.133+0.133,在聚P上冷冻到CVC-T上冷冻到0.102+0.102,在乳房上冷冻到0.124+0.124和+0.079+0.079,每一步的剩余步骤比第一步小到2210万. 这仅限于多肽和乳腺,皮肤冷冻的配置不具有可比性. 而全微调并不引领:在八套中,它只在ETIS上最高,因此两千二百万的可列车参数购买不到五万以上的一致优势,这在最小的DINov2变体上,更新整个编码器的理由最强.

blocks.en: Beyond the first step the domains diverge. In polyp performance continues to rise, CVC-ColonDB gaining + 0.055 +0.055 between ranks 4 and 32; in breast and skin it does not, the corresponding changes being − 0.003 -0.003 , − 0.004 -0.004 and between + 0.001 +0.001 and + 0.005 +0.005 . Skin therefore requires very little adaptation of any kind, a conclusion resting on the flatness of its axis rather than on any frozen baseline. And the in-domain measurement diverges from the out-of-distribution one as it did in the budget control: in breast, rank 4 to rank 32 gains + 0.046 +0.046 on validation while both out-of-distribution sets move by less than 0.005. Additional capacity produces a model that fits the training distribution better without generalising better.
blocks.zh: 第一步之后,这些域是不同的。 在多肽性能持续上升中,CVC-CoronDB在4级和32级之间获得+0.055+0.055;在乳房和皮肤方面没有变化,相应的变化是−0.003-0.03,−0.004-0.04,+0.001+0.001和+0.005. 因此,皮肤几乎不需要任何种类的适应,结论取决于其轴线的平坦性,而不是任何被冻结的基线。 而域内测度与分配外测度与预算控制中的分配外测度不同:在乳房中,在验证时排名第4位为32位增益+0.046+0.046,同时分配外测度均移动小于0.005. 额外的能力可以产生一种模式,更好地适应培训分配,而不作更好的概括。

blocks.en: The axis reads the same in the other metrics (Table 19 ). The first step carries most of the benefit at the boundary as well: from frozen to BitFit, out-of-distribution HD95 falls by between 29 and 75 per cent on the five polyp and breast sets, from 0.196 to 0.139 on CVC-ColonDB and from 0.290 to 0.127 on ETIS, and NSD rises by between 0.13 and 0.29 on all five out-of-distribution sets. The polyp rank effect appears in every metric, CVC-ColonDB HD95 falling from 0.147 at rank 4 to 0.086 at rank 32 and NSD rising from 0.427 to 0.515; in breast, BitFit remains the best configuration out of distribution in NSD on both sets; and skin varies far less, by at most 0.05 in NSD and 0.008 in HD95 across its six configurations on any set.
blocks.zh: 轴读数与其他度量衡相同(表19)。 第一步也带来边界上的大部分好处:从冷冻到BitFit,分配外HD95在5个聚体和乳房中下降29%至75%,在CVC-CoronDB上下降0.196至0.139,在ETIS上上升0.290至0.127,在所有5个分配外的NSD上升0.13至0.29。 polyp阶次效应出现在每个度量衡中,CVC-CoronDB HD95从第4级的0.147降至第32级的0.086,NSD从0.427升至0.515;在乳房中,BitFit仍然是NSD在两套上分布的最佳配置;皮肤差异小得多,在NSD最多为0.05,在HD95中则在任意一套上的6个配置上为0.08.

blocks.en: Two qualifications apply to this section. BitFit received a per-domain learning-rate search whereas LoRA and full fine-tuning did not, which favours BitFit, and every row in Table 19 is single-seed and reported as signal rather than evidence.
blocks.zh: 本节适用两个条件。 BitFit收到一个每个域的学习率搜索,而LORA和全微调则没有,这有利于BitFit,表19中的每行都是单种子并报告为信号而不是证据.

blocks.en: 4.6 Stability of the optimal configuration
blocks.zh: 4.6 最佳配置的稳定性

blocks.en: The preceding sections each reported a comparison; this section examines the comparisons themselves. Because the same comparisons were revisited, at two ranks, at two training budgets, against a second selection criterion, and after correcting a mismatched representational comparison, it is possible to observe which of their conclusions survive. Four comparisons were re-examined. In three an initial finding did not hold: two when a single parameter of that configuration was varied, and one when a mismatch between domains in estimator, rank and sample size was corrected. The fourth compared the same runs under a second selection criterion. A study conducted at a single operating point, which is the norm in this literature, would have reported all four in their original form.
blocks.zh: 前几节各报告比较情况;本节审查比较情况。 由于重新对照第二个甄选标准,在两个等级、两个培训预算中重新进行了同样的比较,并且在纠正了不匹配的代表性比较之后,可以观察到其中哪些结论仍然有效。 重新审查了四项比较。 在三个国家中,一个初步结论没有坚持:两个是该配置的单个参数不同,另一个是估算、排名和样本大小的域间不匹配。 第四个比较了第二个选择标准。 在单一操作点进行的研究是本文献的规范,本可以以原始形式报告所有四个.

blocks.en: 4.6.1 The rank artefact
blocks.zh: 4.6.1 国家 军衔艺术

blocks.en: The comparison between LoRA and full fine-tuning was first conducted at rank 8, with three seeds and Wilcoxon testing, and produced a clear result: full fine-tuning led on two of three skin sets, significantly on both (20 epochs; Table 21 ). At rank 32 the conclusion reverses on ISIC 2016*, from − 0.004 -0.004 ( p = 0.0010 p=0.0010 ) to + 0.003 +0.003 ( p = 0.0023 p=0.0023 ), and weakens on ISIC 2017* from significant to no difference, from − 0.017 -0.017 ( p = 0.0004 p=0.0004 ) to − 0.002 -0.002 ( p = 0.3218 p=0.3218 ), while PH2 favours LoRA at both ranks; the same reversal occurs in polyp, where CVC-ColonDB moves from − 0.024 -0.024 at rank 4 to + 0.022 +0.022 at rank 32 in the single-seed 20-epoch rank sweep. Both configurations are defensible: rank 8 is a common default and was not chosen adversarially, both comparisons used three seeds and significance testing, and both reported p p below 0.05 on ISIC 2016*. A reader given either in isolation, with its methodology fully described, would have no basis for doubting it. What separates them is a single hyperparameter of one of the two methods compared. The finding that full fine-tuning outperforms LoRA is not false at rank 8; it is true at rank 8 and false at rank 32, and reporting it without the rank makes it appear a statement about the methods rather than about one configuration of one of them.
blocks.zh: LoRA与全微调的比较首先在8级进行,有3个种子和威尔科克斯测试,并产生了明确的结果:全微调在3个皮肤组中的2个上,两个上都显著(20个世纪;表21). 在排名32下,国际标准行业分类2016*的结论从−0.004-0.004(p = 0.0010 p = 0.0010)到+0.003+0.003(p = 0.0023 p = 0.0023),并在国际标准行业分类2017* 上从显著到无差别,从−0.017-0.017(p = 0.004 p = 0.04)到−0.002-002(p = 0.3218 p = 0.3218),而PH2在两个级别上都倾向于LORA;在多姿式中也出现同样的逆转,CVC-CoronDB从−0.024-0.024在4级改为0.022+0.022在单视20-epoc级扫描32级。 两种配置都是可以辩驳的:第8级是常见的默认,没有选择对抗性,两种比较都使用了三种种子和意义测试,在国际标准行业分类2016年*上均报告了p以下0.05. 单独阅读,其方法得到充分描述,就没有理由怀疑。 将它们分开的是两种方法之一的一个超参数。 认定完全微调优于LORA的成绩在8级不是假的;在8级是真实的,在32级是虚假的,在没有军衔的情况下进行报告,使得它看起来是一个关于方法的说明,而不是其中一个的配置.

blocks.en: 4.6.2 The selection-criterion artefact
blocks.zh: 4.6.2 国家 选择标准蒿

blocks.en: Selection was performed on in-domain validation DSC throughout, with out-of-distribution scores recorded but unused, which makes it possible to ask after the fact whether the configuration selected was the one best out of distribution. In six independent searches, only one did. In the BitFit learning-rate search in polyp at 40 epochs (Table 22 ), validation selects 1e-3, best on three of five test sets but not on CVC-ClinicDB, where 1e-2 leads by 0.005, or CVC-ColonDB, where 3e-3 leads by 0.009. The plain U-Net search behaves identically, validation selecting 1e-3 while CVC-ColonDB and CVC-T are better served by 3e-3. The BitFit search in skin diverges on one of its three test sets, PH2 being better served by 3e-4 by 0.008. Two remaining instances are of the same kind: in the ResU-Net search validation selected 3e-3 while ETIS was best served by 1e-2, and in the breast rank sweep in-domain performance rose monotonically with rank while out-of-distribution performance did not. The sixth search, BitFit in breast, is the exception: validation selected 3e-3, which was also best on both out-of-distribution sets, at 0.7337 on BrEaST and 0.7449 on BUS-UCLM.
blocks.zh: 选择是在域内验证的 DSC 中全程进行,录制了分配外的分数,但没有使用,这使得在事后可以询问所选择的配置是否是最好的分配. 在六次独立搜索中,只有一次。 BitFit学习率搜索在40 epocs(表22)中选择1e-3,最好在5个测试组中的3个测试组上进行,但不选择CVC-ClinicDB,其中1e-2领先0.005,或CVC-ColonDB,其中3e-3领先0.09. 普通的U-Net搜索行为相同,验证选择1e-3,而CVC-ColonDB和CVC-T则得到3e-3更好的服务. 皮肤中的BitFit搜索在它的三套测试中有一个存在分歧,PH2在0.08前得到3e-4更好的服务. 剩下的两个案例是同类的:在ResU-Net搜索验证中选择3e-3,而ETIS则以1e-2为最佳服务;在胸衔扫描中,域内性能单调上升,排名上升,而分配外性能则没有. 第六次搜索(BitFit in breat)是例外:验证选择了3e-3,这在两种分配外集上也是最好的,在BrEaST上为0.7337,在BUS-UCLM上为0.7449.

blocks.zh: 表22: BitFit学习率搜索, polyp, 40 个纪元. 验证选择 1e-3. 粗体标出每列中的最佳值.

blocks.en: The criterion applied here is rank order on individual test sets: in five of six independent searches, across two hyperparameters and two model families, the validation-optimal configuration was not the out-of-distribution-optimal one on at least one test set. Under a stricter criterion the picture is weaker. Averaged over the three polyp out-of-distribution sets the validation choice is also the best of the four rates, at 0.757 against 0.744 for the nearest alternative, and the two individual divergences of 0.005 and 0.009 fall below the floor; in skin the same criterion costs 0.002, again within it. What the searches establish is therefore that the validation optimum does not coincide with the optimum on every deployment target, not that selecting on validation carries a measurable performance penalty. The direction of the misalignment is structural, since selection must use data available at training time, which is in-domain by construction; its magnitude is small and was not the object of this study.
blocks.zh: 这里应用的标准是单个测试集的排位顺序:在6个独立搜索的5个中,跨越两个超参数和两个模型家族,验证-优化配置并不是至少一个测试集的分流-优化配置. 在一个更严格的标准下,情况会变弱。 平均在三种多聚分配法中确定验证选择也是四种标准中的最佳选择,最接近的替代方法为0.757比0.744,0.005和0.009的两种个别差异均低于下限;在皮肤中,同样的标准成本为0.002,在下限内也是如此. 因此,搜索确定的是,最佳验证与每个部署目标的最佳验证不相吻合,而不是通过验证进行选择会产生可衡量的性能处罚。 错位的方向是结构性的,因为选择必须使用训练时可用的数据,通过构造是内域的;其规模很小,不是本研究的对象.

blocks.en: 4.6.3 The mismatched-comparison artefact
blocks.zh: 4.6.3 联合国 相匹配的动脉

blocks.en: Centred kernel alignment [ 38 ] was used to measure how far each strategy moves the encoder’s representations from their pretrained state, and the initial analysis produced an interpretable result: LoRA preserved the early blocks while full fine-tuning perturbed them throughout, fitting the expectation that a constrained update should stay closer to its initialisation. But three variables differed between the domains analysed, polyp using the biased estimator at rank 32 on one sample size and skin the debiased estimator at rank 8 on another. Repeated under one consistent procedure, the debiased estimator of Nguyen et al. [46] at matched ranks with fixed sample size, the result reverses: LoRA drifts further from the pretrained representation than full fine-tuning, in both domains and at both ranks, with no exception at any block. The estimator was not the cause; the reversal came from the mismatched rank and sample size. The corrected direction is explained by layer-wise decay, which holds full fine-tuning’s lower layers close to initialisation by construction while LoRA applies a uniform rate at every depth. Unlike the first two cases, the original analysis was simply wrong rather than conditional on a defensible choice; it is reported because the corrected finding is used in Section 4.7 , and because the erroneous version was interpretable and fitted theoretical expectation.
blocks.zh: 以内核对齐 [38] 用于衡量每种策略将编码器的表达方式从预训状态移动到什么程度,初步分析得出了可解释的结果: LORA保留了早期的区块,同时全面微调使这些区块在整个过程中受到扰动,符合限制更新应更接近初始化的期望。 但是,在所分析的领域之间有三种变量不同,一种是使用一个样本尺寸的32级偏差估计器,另一种是8级偏差估计器。 根据一贯程序,阮等人的不偏颇估计者一再出现。 [46] 在具有固定样本大小的对应等级,结果反向: 洛拉在两个领域和两个级别上都比全面调整更进一步地从预先培训的代表权中走出去,没有任何区块例外。 估计者不是原因;逆转来自等级和样本大小不匹配。 校正方向由层向衰减来解释,它使全微调的下层接近于通过构造初始化,而LORA则在每个深度都采用统一的速率. 与前两例不同的是,最初的分析完全是错误的,而不是以合理的选择为条件;之所以报告是因为第4.7节使用了经更正的调查结果,而且错误的版本是可解释和符合理论预期的。

blocks.en: 4.6.4 Synthesis

The fourth instability, the epoch-budget artefact, appeared in Section 4.5 because it determined the budget used thereafter; Table 21 summarises all four. The four cases are independent, arising in different experiments. Two follow from varying an operating point, the rank and the budget; the other two are a post-hoc comparison of two selection criteria on the same runs and the correction of a comparison whose estimator, rank and sample size had differed between domains. What they share is that each was interpretable and internally consistent before it was examined a second time: one was supported by significance testing across three seeds, the two operating-point findings were undetectable from within the original experiment, and the mismatched comparison was detectable only by checking its procedure.
blocks.zh: 第四个不稳定因素 -- -- 划时代的预算艺术 -- -- 出现在第4.5节,因为它决定了以后使用的预算;表21概括了所有四个因素。 这四个病例是独立的,产生于不同的实验. 两项是按不同的操作点、等级和预算进行;另外两项是在同一跑道上对两项选择标准进行事后比较,并纠正一项比较,其估计、等级和抽样规模因领域而异。 他们分享的是,在对每个种子进行第二次审查之前,每个种子都是可解释和内部一致的:一个种子得到三个种子的重大测试的支持,两个操作点的发现从最初的实验中无法检测到,不匹配的比较只有通过检查其程序才能检测到.

blocks.en: 4.7 Candidate explanations for the domain effect
blocks.zh: 4.7 域效应的候选解释

blocks.en: The deficit of task-specific training varies by domain and not by architecture or training-set size, and the capacity required varies by domain and not by method. In both cases skin is the least demanding, though the two axes differ on the ordering of polyp and breast. If it could be predicted from a measurable property, a practitioner could estimate in advance whether a foundation model is warranted and what budget it requires. Three analyses were run. Two test candidate predictors of the domain effect: distributional distance between training and test data, and the spectral dimension of the fine-tuning update. The third asks a related question, whether the difference between the two adaptation methods lies in the dimensionality of the solutions they reach. None succeeded, and the negative results are reported because the failure of the obvious explanations is itself informative.
blocks.zh: 具体任务培训的不足因领域不同而不同,而因架构或培训设置大小不同而不同,所需能力因领域不同而不因方法不同而不同. 在这两种情况下,皮肤要求都最低,不过在多肽和乳房的订购方面,两轴不同。 如果可以从可计量的财产中预测,从业者可以事先估计是否有必要建立一个基础模型以及它需要什么预算。 进行了三项分析。 域效应的两个测试候选预测器:训练与测试数据之间的分布距离,以及微调更新的光谱维度. 第三个问题涉及一个相关的问题,即两种适应方法之间的区别是否在于它们所达成的解决办法的维度。 无一成功,而负面结果则被报告,因为明显解释的失败本身就是信息。

blocks.en: Maximum mean discrepancy [ 22 ] was computed between the training set and each test set on features from the pretrained encoder. The measure behaves sensibly on its own terms, the in-domain sets being closest and the estimator returning 0.0380 against a resampled training split and 0.0001 against a shuffled control. The prediction nonetheless fails, and on the most extreme point: CVC-T has the highest MMD 2 at 0.200, nearly twice CVC-ColonDB’s 0.113, yet is the easiest out-of-distribution set at 0.867 under LoRA r = 32 r{=}32 (20 epochs, three-seed mean), twelve points above CVC-ColonDB and seventeen above ETIS. Since every CVC-T image also occurs in CVC-ColonDB (Section 3.2 ), this compares a subset of one collection with the whole of it, which sharpens the dissociation: the subset lies further from the training data than the collection it is drawn from, and is easier. Skin gives the same picture in miniature: PH2 has the largest MMD 2 at 0.0739, an order of magnitude above ISIC 2017* at 0.0070, and is not correspondingly harder. Distance in the pretrained feature space is not difficulty, since a set can be far from the training distribution in a way the encoder registers while remaining easy to segment.
blocks.zh: 计算出培训组与每个测试组之间最大平均差[22],测试的特征来自预先培训的编码器。 该措施在自身条件上表现得敏捷,域内设置最接近,估计器返回0.0380,对复刻式训练分拆,0.0001对洗牌控制. 不过,预测还是失败了,在最极端的一点:CVC-T在0.20时拥有最高的MMD 2,近两倍的CVC-CoronDB的0.113,然而在LORA r = 32 r{=}32(20个历程,三种子平均值),CVC-CoronDB以上十二分,ETIS以上十七分下,是最容易的外分配. 由于每个CVC-T图像也都发生在CVC-CoronDB(第3.2节)中,因此将一个集的子集与整个集进行对比,这样可以使分集更加分解:子集离培训数据更远,而不是它从中提取的,而且更容易. 皮肤在微量中给出了相同的画面: PH2在0.0739时拥有最大的MMD 2,比国际标准行业分类2017年* 0.0070时的量级要高,没有相应的难度. 预先训练的特征空间的距离并不困难,因为一个集在编码器登记时可能与培训分布相去甚远,而很容易分割。

blocks.en: The second candidate addresses the adaptation axis. If a domain requires a higher rank, the update full fine-tuning finds might itself be higher-dimensional, and the singular value spectrum of that update was computed across all encoder blocks. Measured as the number of singular directions capturing 90 per cent of the update’s energy, it is 28.4 in skin, 39.0 in breast and 42.1 in polyp at 20 epochs (Table 23 ). At 20 epochs the measure tracks the ordering, skin lowest and polyp highest, but two problems prevent it being a usable predictor. It separates the domains far less than the rank sweep does, spectral dimension spanning a factor of 1.5 against eight for rank, and breast sits closer to polyp than to skin on this measure while behaving like skin on the capacity axis at the extended budget. And the measure is budget-sensitive, breast rising from 39.0 to 44.3 between 20 and 40 epochs, a change larger than the gap between breast and polyp at either budget, so it is not intrinsic to the domain: the epoch-budget artefact in a second guise.
blocks.zh: 第二个候选项目涉及适应轴。 如果一个域需要更高的排名,更新的全微调发现本身可能是更高的维度,该更新的单值频谱是在所有编码器块中计算出来的. 按捕获90%更新能量的单向数量计算,在20个纪元时,皮肤为28.4个,乳房为39.0个,多肽为42.1个(表23)。 在20个纪元时,测量会跟踪订单,皮肤最低和多肽最高,但有两个问题阻止它成为可用的预测器. 它将域分隔得远小于分级扫描,光谱维度为分级1.5对8的系数,乳房坐在这个测量上比皮肤更接近聚P,同时在扩展的预算中表现得像能力轴上的皮肤. 而这一措施对预算有敏感认识,在20至40个世纪之间,乳房从39.0上升到44.3,这个变化比两个预算的乳房和多乳房之间的差距要大,因此它不是这个领域所固有的:以第二个伪装的时代预算动脉。

blocks.en: Table 23: Spectral properties of the full fine-tuning update. The reported quantity is the number of singular directions capturing 90 per cent of the update’s energy. Polyp and skin at 20 epochs.
blocks.zh: 表23 全面微调更新的光谱属性. 报告的数量是捕捉90%更新能量的单数。 在20个纪元时,多肽和皮肤。

blocks.en: The third analysis asks whether the difference between LoRA and full fine-tuning lies in the dimensionality of the solution each finds. The full fine-tuning update was truncated by singular value decomposition across all modified two-dimensional encoder weight matrices, with one-dimensional parameters kept at their fine-tuned values, and added back to the pretrained weights (polyp, 20 epochs, seed 42; Table 24 ). Truncating to rank 32 costs at most 0.007 on any set, and at rank 4 the two methods separate slightly, LoRA leading on CVC-ClinicDB by + 0.033 +0.033 . The full fine-tuning update examined can therefore be approximated at low rank, though the truncation covers every modified encoder weight matrix while LoRA modifies only the query and value projections, so the two solution spaces are not identical.
blocks.zh: 第三项分析询问LORA与充分微调之间的区别是否在于每个解决方案的维度. 全部微调更新被所有修改后的二维编码器重量矩阵的单值分解截断,一维参数按其微调值保留,并加入到预先训练的重量中(polyp, 20 epoc, 种子 42;表24 ). 在任何设定上,将成本排在32位,最高为0.007;在4位,两种方法略有分离,LORA在CVC-ClinicDB上领先+0.033+0.033. 因此,所检查的全部微调更新可以低级进行近似化,尽管调值覆盖了每一个修改后的编码器重量矩阵,而LORA只修改了查询和数值预测,所以两个解码空间并不相同.

blocks.en: Table 24: Truncated full fine-tuning against LoRA, polyp, 20 epochs, seed 42 (single seed). Truncation columns report the update projected onto its leading r r singular directions; LoRA columns an adapter trained at the same rank. These are 20-epoch checkpoints, distinct from the 40-epoch runs of Table 19 ; the LoRA r = 32 r{=}32 run is the seed-42 member of the three-seed mean in Table 16 .
blocks.zh: 表24:对洛拉,多普,20个纪元,第42号种子(单籽)的截断全细调整. 截断列将预测的更新报告到其主要 r 单数方向; LORA 列一个训练有素的适配器。 这些检查站是20个划时代的检查站,不同于表19的40个划时代的跑道;LORA r = 32 r {=}32 跑道是表16中三种子平均值中的种子-42成员.

blocks.en: Two measurements were taken as candidate predictors and neither yields a usable rule, one failing to track the ordering and the other tracking it at one budget but moving with the budget; the truncation analysis addresses a different question, and the corrected analysis of Section 4.6 adds a further negative result, ruling out the account under which LoRA generalises better by staying closer to its initialisation. The domain-dependence is therefore an empirical regularity established across two axes and, on the capacity axis, two methods sharing no mechanism, and it remains without a mechanistic account.
blocks.zh: 作为候选预测者,采取了两项衡量标准,但都没有产生有用的规则,一项没有跟踪定单,另一项则在一个预算中跟踪定单,但随预算而移动;缩短分析涉及另一个问题,对第4.6节的更正分析又增加了一个负面结果,排除了LORA通过接近初始化而更好地概括的账户。 因此,域的依赖性是一种经验性的规律性,它跨越两个轴线,在能力轴线上,两种方法共享无机制,它仍然没有机械化的账户。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Adaptation
blocks.zh: 5.1 适应

blocks.en: Four findings concern adaptation itself: where it helps, what it costs, how much of it is needed, and how far comparisons of it can be trusted. 1. The advantage of adaptation lies out of distribution. Where the deployment target is the training distribution and the full training set is available, no accuracy advantage for adaptation was observed. Averaged over the two in-domain polyp test sets the plain U-Net scores within the measurement floor of the adapted model, at fewer parameters and no pretraining, and in breast both task-specific models score above it on the validation split, though that split also served for model selection. On the smaller polyp subsets adaptation does lead. Where the target is data from a different institution, scanner or protocol, adaptation leads on every set examined: all sixteen comparisons across eight sets and two independently tuned architectures, although the two on CVC-T repeat those on CVC-ColonDB rather than adding independent evidence. Recomputed without CVC-T, the polyp out-of-distribution means fall, but no ordering, sign or trend reported in Section 4 changes (Table 25 ). The margin varies by more than a factor of ten and is conditional on training-set size in a specific way: within a domain more data reduces it, but across domains data volume does not predict it. 2. The advantage has a cost in small lesions and fine boundaries. It is not uniform across metrics and kinds of error (Section 4.3 ): it holds in overlap, sensitivity, precision and HD95, but at the finest boundary scale the task-specific models are as good or better at 224 pixels, and the adapted model more often misses a small lesion altogether, 13 polyp images at the selected configuration against none for the plain U-Net. 3. Little adaptation is needed. The step from a frozen encoder to BitFit captures most of the available benefit in polyp and breast, and beyond it LoRA at 2.7 per cent of the parameters is equal or ahead of full fine-tuning in DSC, IoU and NSD on all five polyp sets across three seeds. The equality does not extend to every metric: LoRA’s precision is significantly lower on all three polyp out-of-distribution sets, so at equal DSC it covers more of each lesion and more of its surroundings. 4. In-domain orderings do not reliably carry over, and conclusions depend on the operating point. Between architectures (Section 4.1 ), between data scales (Section 4.4 ) and along the adaptation axis (Section 4.5 ), the ordering or optimum identified on held-out data from the training distribution did not reliably carry over to data from a different source. The budget control of Section 4.5.3 separates the two regimes within a single experiment: doubling the epoch budget in breast largely dissolved the out-of-distribution rank effect while leaving the in-domain effect intact. Of the four cases in Section 4.6 , three revised a finding: two reversed or weakened when the LoRA rank or the training budget was changed, one of them despite significance testing across three seeds, and one reversed once a mismatched comparison was corrected; in each the original version claimed the larger effect. The fourth compared two selection criteria post hoc on the same runs.

blocks.en: 5.2 Domain
blocks.zh: 5.2 领域

blocks.en: The clearest result of this work is that the amount of adaptation required belongs to the domain rather than to the method. The rank at which adaptation ceases to improve varies across the three domains, polyp continuing to improve to rank 32, breast plateauing at 16 and skin showing no movement beyond rank 4 under the 20-epoch protocol, though Section 4.5.3 shows the breast effect largely dissolves out of distribution at twice that budget. Polyp is also the one domain where BitFit falls behind, while skin and breast are served by the smallest budget tested under both methods. That two methods differing by a factor of eleven in parameter count, in intervention site, and in whether they possess a rank parameter at all place the same domain above the others locates the requirement in the domain. Other configuration choices behave the same way: the learning rate selected on validation differed between architectures and between domains, and the optimal budget differed by domain, so a study on any one of these domains would have produced an internally consistent set of settings that does not transfer to the other two.
blocks.zh: 这项工作最明显的结果是,所需适应量属于域而非方法. 适应不再改善的等级因三个领域而异,多肽继续提升到第32位,乳腺在16位高原化,皮肤在20世纪协议下没有超过第4位的移动,尽管第4.5.3节显示乳腺效应在预算的两倍上基本上无法分配。 Polyp也是BitFit落后的一个域,而皮肤和乳房则由两种方法测试的最小预算服务. 在参数计数、干预地点以及它们是否拥有一个排名参数时,这两种方法因系数11而不同,它们是否将同一域置于其他域之上,从而确定域内的要求。 其他的配置选择表现相同:在验证时选择的学习率在架构之间和域之间有所不同,最佳预算因域而异,因此对其中任何一个域的研究会产生一套内部一致的设置,不会转移到另外两个域.

blocks.en: The architecture axis places the domains in a related but not identical order. Both axes separate skin from the other two, skin showing the smallest deficit of task-specific training as well as the smallest capacity requirement, but they differ on polyp and breast, the mean deficit in Table 7 being larger in breast than in polyp under both architectures. Four explanations for the domain-dependence can be set aside. It is not the task-specific architecture, since the deficit holds under two such models with identical sign on all eight sets, the simpler being the stronger out of distribution. It is not the method, since the ordering holds under LoRA and BitFit, which share no mechanism. It is not distance in the pretrained feature space, since the polyp set with the highest discrepancy is the easiest. And it is not the encoder family, since the same transformer without adaptation reaches 0.614 out of distribution in polyp against 0.737 for the plain U-Net and in breast falls within the measurement floor of the plain U-Net, so the advantage appears only once adaptation is applied. Architecture and pretraining remain confounded, since no convolutional encoder pretrained at comparable scale was included, but the frozen result shows the encoder family alone does not produce the effect. Training-set size is a fifth candidate and is only partly addressed: on the architecture axis the deficit does not follow a simple ordering by size, skin at 518 images showing a much smaller gap than polyp at 652.
blocks.zh: 架构轴将域置于一个相关但不相同的顺序. 两轴将皮肤与另外两轴分开,皮肤显示出任务特定训练的最小缺陷以及最小的能力要求,但在多肽和乳腺上却有所不同,表7中的平均缺损在乳腺中大于两种结构下的多肽. 关于域依赖的四种解释可以搁置. 它不是针对具体任务的架构,因为赤字在两种模式下都存在,在所有八套模式上都有一个相同的标志,最简单的是更强大的分配。 这不是这个方法,因为订单在没有机制的LORA和BitFit下持有. 它不是在预先训练的特征空间中的距离,因为差异最大的聚p集是最简单的. 而且它也不是编码器家族,因为没有适应的同一变压器在聚P中的分配量达到0.614,而平原U-Net中的分配量为0.737,在乳房中则属于平原U-Net的测量底部,所以这个优势只在应用适应时才出现. 建筑和预训仍然令人困惑,因为没有包含在可比规模上预训的旋律编码器,但冷冻的结果表明,单靠编码器家族并不能产生效果. 训练设置大小是第五个候选,只是部分解决:在架构轴上,赤字没有按照大小的简单顺序排列,在518张图像上显示差距比在652张多普小得多.

blocks.en: The ordering also conceals a difference in what kind of shift each test set represents. Two of three skin sets are earlier releases of the training archive, suggesting skin’s small deficit reflects a milder shift rather than a property of dermoscopy. The prediction that follows fails: PH2, the only independent skin source, should show the largest skin deficit and under the plain U-Net shows the smallest. Within-domain variation is of comparable magnitude, so treating the domain as the unit of analysis is a simplification the test-set-level results only partly support.
blocks.zh: 订单还掩盖了每个测试集代表何种班次的不同. 三套皮肤中有两套是早期的训练档案,说明皮肤小的缺损反映的是较温和的转变,而不是皮肤检查。 以下预测失败: PH2是唯一独立的皮肤来源,应该显示最大的皮肤缺损,在平原U-Net下显示最小. 域内变异具有可比较的大小,因此将域作为分析的单位,只是简化了测试设置级结果,只是部分支持.

blocks.en: The account most consistent with the results is that domains differ in how much of the required update is task-general rather than domain-specific, and that pretraining supplies the former. A foundation model arrives with representations encoding much of what segmentation requires, and adaptation supplies only the domain-specific remainder. Where that remainder is small, little capacity is needed and pretraining transfers well; where it is large, more is needed, and a model trained from random initialisation must learn the general component from target data alone, which it can do well enough to fit the training distribution but not well enough to transfer. This fits four observations: why the first step on the capacity axis carries most of the benefit, why the requirement is method-independent, why task-specific models are competitive in domain but not out of it, and why more data narrows the in-domain gap faster. It was not tested, and Section 4.7 records the closest attempt.
blocks.zh: 与结果最符合的说法是,所需更新中有多少是一般任务,而不是特定领域,域名不同,而且预训提供前者。 一个基础模型的到来,其表述编码了大部分分区要求,而适应只提供特定域的剩余部分。 如果剩余部分很小,则不需要多少能力,而且培训前的转让也很好;如果规模很大,则需要更多的能力,而从随机初始化中培训出来的模型必须仅从目标数据中学习一般部分,这样就可以很好地适应培训的分布,但不足以进行转让。 这符合四种观点:为什么能力轴上的第一步包含大部分好处,为什么要求是方法独立的,为什么特定任务模型在域内具有竞争力,而不是脱离域外,为什么更多的数据能更快地缩小域内差距. 未进行测试,第4.7节记录了最近的尝试。

blocks.en: That the plain variant outperforms the residual one is itself unexpected, and the most plausible reconciliation is scale. Residual connections address optimisation difficulty in deep networks, and at five encoder levels and under eight million parameters that difficulty may not arise, leaving the additional skip projections as parameters that fit the training distribution without contributing out of distribution. This is untested here.
blocks.zh: 平坦的变体超越剩余变体本身是出乎意料的,最可行的调节是规模。 剩余连接处理深层网络的优化困难,在5个编码层和800万个参数下可能不会出现这种困难,使额外的跳过预测成为适合训练分配的参数,而不会促进分配。 这是未经检验的

blocks.en: 5.3 Practical recommendations
blocks.zh: 5.3 实际建议

blocks.en: The first four recommendations are for practitioners choosing between the approaches, the last two for studies comparing them. 1. Use an adapted foundation model when the model will be deployed on data from other sites, scanners or protocols. It led on all eight out-of-distribution test sets under both task-specific architectures, in DSC, IoU, sensitivity and HD95, and its lead grows as training data shrink, most clearly in polyp. When deployment stays within the training source and the full training set is available, a well-configured U-Net is sufficient: no accuracy advantage for adaptation was observed there, and the case for a foundation model must then rest on engineering effort or on one backbone serving several tasks. 2. Start with the smallest adaptation and do not default to full fine-tuning. Moving from a frozen encoder to BitFit captures most of the benefit in polyp and breast, and LoRA at 2.7 per cent of the parameters equalled or exceeded full fine-tuning in DSC on all five polyp sets. 3. Sweep the adaptation capacity on the target domain instead of inheriting it. The LoRA rank required ranged from 4 in skin to 32 in polyp, and the same domain pattern appeared under BitFit, so a value tuned on another dataset is not a valid default. 4. Check small lesions and boundaries explicitly before deployment. At 224 pixels the adapted model missed small polyps entirely where the U-Nets did not, and a U-Net traced boundaries more precisely on four of the five polyp and breast out-of-distribution sets. Where small lesions or exact boundaries matter, report sensitivity, empty predictions and NSD alongside DSC, and evaluate at the highest resolution the budget allows: at 392 pixels the adapted model led in NSD on all three skin sets. 5. Report in-domain and out-of-distribution results separately. An in-domain result is not evidence for cross-site deployment: on all three axes studied here the in-domain ordering did not reliably carry over out of distribution, and in Section 4.5.3 the two regimes diverged within a single experiment. 6. Establish a measurement floor, and vary the operating point, before reporting a difference as a property of a method. Repeated runs at an identical seed differed by up to 0.013 DSC, of the same order as the improvements this literature commonly reports, and two findings here reversed or weakened when the LoRA rank or the training budget was changed; where a comparison involves a hyperparameter of one method, establish the conclusion at more than one value of it.
blocks.zh: 前四项建议是供实践者在方法之间作出选择,最后两项是供研究比较。 1. 当该模型将部署在其他站点、扫描仪或协议的数据上时,使用经过调整的基础模型。 它在两种任务特定架构下,在DSC,IoU,灵敏度和HD95中,领导了所有8个分配外测试集,它的领先随着培训数据收缩而增长,最明显的是在多聚p中. 当部署停留在培训来源之内,而且有全套培训时,配置良好的U-Net就足够了:在那里没有观察到适应的准确性优势,因此,基础模型的理由必须取决于工程努力或一个骨干,服务于几项任务。 2.从最小调整开始,不默认为全面微调. 从冷冻编码器向BitFit移动,在多肽和乳腺中捕捉到大部分好处,在DSC中所有5个多肽集中,以2.7%的参数等于或超过全部微调的LORA. 3. 扫清目标领域的适应能力,而不是继承。 需要的LORA级别从皮肤的4位到多肽的32位不等,同样的域图案出现在BitFit下,因此在另一个数据集上调值并不是有效的默认. 4. 在部署之前明确检查小伤和边界。 在224像素时,经过调整的模型完全忽略了U-Nets没有的地方的小聚体,一个U-Net更准确地追踪了五个聚体和乳房外分配装置中的四个的边界。 如果小损伤或精确的边界很重要,报告敏感度、空预测和NSD与DSC并列,并以最高分辨率评价预算允许:在392像素时,在NSD中引导所有三套皮肤的模型。 5. 分别报告域内和分配外结果。 域内结果不是跨地点部署的证据:在此处研究的所有三个轴上,域内命令没有可靠地完成分配,在第4.5.3节中,两个制度在单一试验中存在分歧。 6. 在报告差异作为方法属性之前,确定一个测量底线,并更改操作点。 重复运行在相同的种子上,最高为0.013 DSC,与本文献通常报告的改进顺序相同,在LORA排名或培训预算改变时,这里有两个结论颠倒或削弱;如果比较涉及一种方法的超参数,则以一个以上值确定结论。

It led on all eight out-of-distribution test sets under both task-specific architectures, in DSC, IoU, sensitivity and HD95, and its lead grows as training data shrink, most clearly in polyp. When deployment stays within the training source and the full training set is available, a well-configured U-Net is sufficient: no accuracy advantage for adaptation was observed there, and the case for a foundation model must then rest on engineering effort or on one backbone serving several tasks.
blocks.zh: 当该模型将部署在其他站点,扫描仪或协议的数据上时,使用一个经过调整的基础模型. 它在两种任务特定架构下,在DSC,IoU,灵敏度和HD95中,领导了所有8个分配外测试集,它的领先随着培训数据收缩而增长,最明显的是在多聚p中. 当部署停留在培训来源之内,而且有全套培训时,配置良好的U-Net就足够了:在那里没有观察到适应的准确性优势,因此,基础模型的理由必须取决于工程努力或一个骨干,服务于几项任务。

blocks.en: Start with the smallest adaptation and do not default to full fine-tuning. Moving from a frozen encoder to BitFit captures most of the benefit in polyp and breast, and LoRA at 2.7 per cent of the parameters equalled or exceeded full fine-tuning in DSC on all five polyp sets.
blocks.zh: 从最小的适应开始,不默认为完全微调. 从冷冻编码器向BitFit移动,在多肽和乳腺中捕捉到大部分好处,在DSC中所有5个多肽集中,以2.7%的参数等于或超过全部微调的LORA.

blocks.en: Sweep the adaptation capacity on the target domain instead of inheriting it. The LoRA rank required ranged from 4 in skin to 32 in polyp, and the same domain pattern appeared under BitFit, so a value tuned on another dataset is not a valid default.
blocks.zh: 扫清目标域的适应能力而不是继承. 需要的LORA级别从皮肤的4位到多肽的32位不等,同样的域图案出现在BitFit下,因此在另一个数据集上调值并不是有效的默认.

blocks.en: Check small lesions and boundaries explicitly before deployment. At 224 pixels the adapted model missed small polyps entirely where the U-Nets did not, and a U-Net traced boundaries more precisely on four of the five polyp and breast out-of-distribution sets. Where small lesions or exact boundaries matter, report sensitivity, empty predictions and NSD alongside DSC, and evaluate at the highest resolution the budget allows: at 392 pixels the adapted model led in NSD on all three skin sets.
blocks.zh: 在部署前明确检查小型损伤和边界。 在224像素时,经过调整的模型完全忽略了U-Nets没有的地方的小聚体,一个U-Net更准确地追踪了五个聚体和乳房外分配装置中的四个的边界。 如果小损伤或精确的边界很重要,报告敏感度、空预测和NSD与DSC并列,并以最高分辨率评价预算允许:在392像素时,在NSD中引导所有三套皮肤的模型。

blocks.en: Report in-domain and out-of-distribution results separately. An in-domain result is not evidence for cross-site deployment: on all three axes studied here the in-domain ordering did not reliably carry over out of distribution, and in Section 4.5.3 the two regimes diverged within a single experiment.
blocks.zh: 分别报告域内分配和区外分配结果. 域内结果不是跨地点部署的证据:在此处研究的所有三个轴上,域内命令没有可靠地完成分配,在第4.5.3节中,两个制度在单一试验中存在分歧。

blocks.en: Establish a measurement floor, and vary the operating point, before reporting a difference as a property of a method. Repeated runs at an identical seed differed by up to 0.013 DSC, of the same order as the improvements this literature commonly reports, and two findings here reversed or weakened when the LoRA rank or the training budget was changed; where a comparison involves a hyperparameter of one method, establish the conclusion at more than one value of it.
blocks.zh: 建立测量底线,并更改操作点,然后报告差异作为方法属性。 重复运行在相同的种子上,最高为0.013 DSC,与本文献通常报告的改进顺序相同,在LORA排名或培训预算改变时,这里有两个结论颠倒或削弱;如果比较涉及一种方法的超参数,则以一个以上值确定结论。

blocks.en: 5.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.4 限制

blocks.en: Seven limitations bound these recommendations, each with the study that would remove it. 1. A single backbone. All four adaptation strategies were applied to DINOv2-Small, so while the capacity requirement is shown not to be specific to the adaptation method, whether it is specific to the backbone was not tested, and these results do not recommend DINOv2 over other backbones. Repeating the adaptation axis on a second encoder such as SAM under an identical protocol would settle this. 2. Asymmetric tuning. BitFit received a per-domain learning-rate search while LoRA and full fine-tuning used rates held constant from earlier experiments, which favours BitFit, and part of its standing may reflect that search. The task-specific learning-rate search was conducted on polyp alone, and in skin the plain variant ran at the residual variant’s rate. 3. Mostly single-seed results. Only the core comparison between LoRA and full fine-tuning used three seeds and significance testing; the capacity axis, BitFit, the plain U-Net and the data-size sweep are reported as signal and read against the measurement floor of Section 3.6 . Three configurations run three times each would give a per-domain variance estimate. 4. Three domains. They establish that the capacity requirement varies by domain, but not what determines it or how to anticipate it for a fourth domain without its data; answering that requires more domains under one protocol. Whether the requirement also varies with training-set size was not tested, since the rank sweep used one training-set size per domain, and the domain ordering should not be extrapolated beyond the three domains studied. 5. Training-set range. In-domain parity was observed at the full training sets, of 479 to 2,075 images, and in breast down to 119 images, while on the smaller polyp subsets adaptation led; where parity breaks down was not located, so these results do not show pretraining unnecessary in domain in general. 6. A minimal decoder. The linear decoder isolates encoder adaptation but makes the frozen configuration a minimal baseline; repeating the frozen and BitFit configurations with a convolutional decoder would separate the decoder’s contribution. 7. The breast in-domain figure. It comes from the validation split, which was also used for early stopping, and is therefore optimistically biased. Polyp’s in-domain sets are separate from the validation split, and skin has no in-domain figure.
blocks.zh: 7项限制将这些建议捆绑在一起,每项限制都与将取消这些建议的研究联系在一起。 1. 单一骨干。 所有四种适应战略都应用于DINOv2-Small,因此虽然显示能力要求并不针对适应方法,但是否针对主干线的特异性没有经过测试,这些结果并不推荐DINOv2优于其他主干线. 在一个相同的协议下在第二个编码器(如SAM)上重复调整轴就可以解决这个问题。 2. 不对称调理。 BitFit收到了一个每个域的学习率搜索,而LORA和全微调使用的速率保持了早期实验的恒定,这有利于BitFit,其部分状态可能反映了这种搜索. 任务特定的学习率搜索是单对多肽进行的,在皮肤中,平原变体以剩余变体的速度运行。 3. 多数为单一种子结果。 只有LORA和全微调的核心比较使用了三个种子和意义测试;容量轴,BitFit,平原U-Net和数据大小扫描被报告为信号,并对照3.6节的测量底部阅读. 三个配置各运行三次,得出每个域的差异估计数。 4. 三个领域。 它们确定,能力要求因领域而异,但决定它的因素或在没有数据的情况下如何预测第四个领域;答案是同一个协议要求更多的领域。 要求是否也随着训练设置大小的不同而不同,没有经过测试,因为军衔扫荡每个域都使用了一个训练设置大小,域令不应该被推导出所研究的三个域之外. 5. 培训范围。 在全部培训中观察到了域内均等,即479至2 075幅图像,在乳房中则下降到119幅图像,而在较小的聚P子集上则导致适应;在未找到均等分解的地方,这些结果并不显示一般领域不必要的预训. 6. 最小的解码器。 线性解码器隔离编码器的适应性,但使冷冻配置成为最低限度的基线;重复冷冻配置和BitFit配置,加上一个转录解码器,可以分离解码器的贡献. 7. 境内乳房图。 其来源于验证分裂,也曾用于早停,因此乐观偏颇. Polyp的域内集与验证拆分分开,皮肤没有域内图.

blocks.en: 5.5 Relation to previous work
blocks.zh: 5.5 与以往工作的关系

blocks.en: Evaluation hazards in standard benchmarks. Two hazards in the data used here were found by content-based checks that file-hash comparison does not replicate. In the polyp protocol, a pixel-level comparison shows that all 60 CVC-T images are identical to images in CVC-ColonDB, as are 59 of their 60 masks, while no file is byte-identical, so an md5 check passes; this is consistent with EndoScene defining its images as drawn from CVC-ColonDB [ 62 ] . Studies following the standard protocol therefore count these images twice when reporting generalisation. In the breast training source, a perceptual hash at a Hamming distance of five or less placed 212 of the 647 lesion-bearing BUSI images in 98 near-duplicate groups, only one of which contains byte-identical files; keeping one image per group removed 114 images (17.6 per cent of the 647), and inspection of a sample of four groups showed the same acquisitions annotated twice with differing masks. The count depends on the threshold, from 89 images (13.8 per cent) at a distance of three to 137 (21.2 per cent) at eight. All 114 were removed before any experiment reported here.
blocks.zh: 在标准基准中评估危害。 通过基于内容的检查发现,此处使用的数据中有两个危险,即文件记录比较没有复制。 在多像素协议中,一个像素级比较显示,所有60张CVC-T图像与CVC-ColonDB中的图像完全相同,如同他们的60张口罩中的59张一样,而没有文件是字节-同义的,因此是md5的检查通过;这与EndoScene定义其从CVC-ColonDB[62]中绘制的图像是一致的. 因此,按照标准协议进行的研究在报告一般化时将这些图像计算两次。 在乳房训练来源中,在距离Hamming5个或不到5个距离处的感知散列将647张带有损伤的BUSI图像中的212张放在98个近重复组中,其中只有一个包含字节相同的文件;每组保留一张图像就移除了114张图像(占647张图像的17.6%),对4组样本的检查显示,有两次附加说明的有不同口罩的同一采购。 计数取决于阈值,从距离3到137(21.2%)的89幅图像(13.8%)为8幅. 在报告任何实验之前,所有114个都被移除。

blocks.en: That LoRA matches full fine-tuning at a fraction of the parameters is established outside medical imaging and is confirmed here, and the BitFit result extends a claim reported for language tasks in low-data regimes to dense prediction on medical images and to cross-dataset evaluation, neither of which the original work or its medical successors examine.
blocks.zh: LORA在部分参数上与完全微调匹配是医学成像之外确定的,并在这里得到证实,BitFit结果将低数据系统中报告的语言任务的索赔扩展至医学成像上的密集预测和跨数据集评价,而原始工作或其医学继任者都没有对此进行检查.

blocks.en: More interesting is the disagreement of Section 2.3 . Dutt et al. [17] attribute the ordering among methods to data volume; Teuber et al. [58] attribute it to dataset characteristics. These results support the second, and support the explanation it offers for the disagreement: Section 4.5 finds BitFit ahead of LoRA on both breast out-of-distribution sets, level on all three skin sets, and behind on one polyp set, a ranking that changes with the dataset rather than holding globally. A study on any one of these domains would report a different ordering, each correct about its own, so the disagreement need not be an error on either side. One difference in scope should be noted alongside the agreement. Their base model is SAM, supervised on segmentation masks, whereas DINOv2 has never seen one, so the amount of adaptation each requires is not the same quantity; and their evaluation does not separate in-domain from cross-dataset performance, whereas that divergence is the central finding here.
blocks.zh: 更有趣的是第2.3节的分歧。 Dutt 等 (英语). [17] 将方法之间的顺序归因于数据量; [58] 将其归属于数据集特性. 这些结果支持第二套,并支持它为分歧提供的解释:第4.5节在乳房外分配装置、所有三个皮肤装置的电位以及后面的一个聚P装置上发现BitFit领先于LORA, 这一排名随着数据集而改变,而不是在全球维持。 对其中任何一个领域的研究将报告一个不同的顺序,每个顺序都正确,因此分歧不必是任何一方的错误. 除了协定之外,还应注意到范围上的一个差异。 它们的基础模型是SAM,由分解口罩监督,而DINOv2从未见过一个,因此每个需要的适应量并不相同;它们的评价并没有将域内性能与跨数据集性能区分开来,而这种差异是这里的核心发现.

blocks.en: Isensee et al. [31] report strong performance from residual-encoder configurations, which motivated the residual variant used here. Under the conditions of this study, that variant, with residual blocks in both encoder and decoder, did not outperform its plain counterpart. Because it is not the nnU-Net ResEnc configuration and the setting differs, three-dimensional and multi-class on larger datasets there, two-dimensional and binary here, the result does not test their recommendation directly.
blocks.zh: Isensee等人[31]报告了残余编码器配置的强效性能,这推动了此处使用的残余变体. 根据本研究的条件,该变体在编码器和解码器中都有残余块,其性能并没有超过其平面对应物. 因为它不是 nnU-Net ResEnc 配置,而且设置不同,三维和多类的大型数据集,这里的二维和二进制,结果不会直接测试他们的推荐.

blocks.en: The literature on foundation models for medical segmentation generally reports adapted models outperforming task-specific training. These results agree out of distribution and disagree in domain, finding no advantage in either domain where an in-domain comparison is possible, with parity reached at 119 training images in breast, against baselines Section 4.2 shows competitive with published architectures. The discrepancy is most likely one of evaluation regime rather than of result: studies reporting an advantage frequently evaluate on data from the training distribution or do not distinguish the regimes, and where the distinction is drawn the advantage concentrates entirely out of distribution. This locates the existing result more precisely rather than contradicting it.
blocks.zh: 有关医疗隔离基础模型的文献一般都报告,经过调整的模型超过了针对具体任务的培训。 这些结果与分布一致,在域内存在分歧,发现在两个域都没有任何优势,可以进行域内比较,与基线第4.2节相比,在乳房中达到119个培训图像的对等,显示出与已公布架构的竞争力。 这种差异最有可能是评价制度而不是结果:报告数据优势的研究经常从培训分配中评价数据,或者没有区分制度,如果加以区分,则优势将完全脱离分配。 这更准确地确定了现有结果,而不是与之相矛盾。

blocks.en: Independent support comes from breadth rather than depth. U-Bench [ 57 ] reports that improvements under zero-shot generalisation are more consistently significant than those measured in domain, which is the same divergence between regimes observed from the opposite direction: where this work finds an in-domain measurement failing to predict out-of-distribution behaviour, U-Bench finds the out-of-distribution measurement separating methods the in-domain one does not.
blocks.zh: 独立的支持来自宽度而不是深度. U-Bench [57] 报告说,零射通化下的改进比域内测得的改进更为一致,这是从相反方向观测到的系统之间的相同差异:如果这项工作发现域内测量无法预测分配外行为,U-Bench发现分配外测量分离方法的域内测量不.

blocks.en: Finally, the comparison drawn throughout this study is binary, and a recent line of work pursues a third option: distilling foundation-model representations into a lightweight architecture so that the result carries those priors at the parameter count of a U-Net. Polyp-DiFoM [ 1 ] distils SAM, DINOv2, OneFormer and Mask2Former into U-Net students and evaluates on the same five polyp sets used here. This follows from the present comparison rather than competing with it: if the advantage is concentrated out of distribution and a lightweight architecture already matches in domain, transferring that component into the smaller model is the natural next step, and the domain dependence found here implies that a distillation method validated on one domain should not be assumed to transfer either.
blocks.zh: 最后,在整个研究过程中所作的比较是二进制的,最近的一项工作是追求第三种选择:将基础模型表示法蒸馏成轻量级架构,从而使结果在U-Net的参数计数中将这些前缀带入U-Net. Polyp-DifoM [1] distrils SAM, DINOv2, OneFormer和Mask2Former, 并评估到U-Net的学生中,对这里使用的相同的五套多普进行评价. 这是从目前的比较中得出的,而不是与之竞争的:如果优势集中在分布之外,而轻量级架构已经在域中匹配,那么将该组件转移到较小的模型中是自然的下一步,在这里发现的域依赖意味着在一个域上验证的蒸馏方法也不应该被假定为转移.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This study compared foundation-model adaptation with task-specific training from scratch for medical image segmentation, separating in-domain from out-of-distribution evaluation across three domains and eight out-of-distribution test sets. Three conclusions follow. 1. Adaptation is warranted when the deployment target differs from the training source: an adapted DINOv2 outperformed two independently tuned U-Nets on all eight out-of-distribution sets in DSC, IoU, sensitivity and HD95, whereas within the training distribution and at the full training set a well-configured U-Net matched it. 2. Little adaptation is needed: bias-only tuning captures most of the benefit, and LoRA at 2.7 per cent of the parameters equals or exceeds full fine-tuning in DSC on all five polyp sets. 3. How much adaptation is needed is a property of the domain rather than of the method, varying eightfold in LoRA rank across domains and reproduced by a method with no rank parameter, so capacity must be selected on the target domain. These results were obtained with DINOv2, a small, general-purpose foundation model never trained on segmentation masks or medical images; larger or medical-specific foundation models would be expected to perform at least as well.
blocks.zh: 这项研究将基础模型适应与针对特定任务的培训进行比较,从零开始用于医疗图像分解,将域内与分解外评价区分为三个领域和八套分解外测试。 以下三个结论。 1. 当部署目标与培训来源不同时,有必要进行调整:经过调整的DINOv2在DSC、IoU、灵敏度和HD95中的所有8套分配装置上都比两个独立调制的U-Net强,而在培训分配和全面培训中,一个配置良好的U-Net与之匹配。 2. 不需要作什么调整:只偏偏调能捕捉到大部分好处,而所有5套聚P的DSC中2.7%的参数等于或超过全部微调。 3. 需要多少适应是域而不是方法的属性,LORA的八倍不同排名跨域,用没有排名参数的方法复制,因此必须在目标域上选择能力. 这些结果与DINOv2一起获得,这是一个从未受过分区口罩或医疗图像培训的小型通用基础模型;预计大型或医学专用的基础模型至少也将发挥作用。

blocks.en: Adaptation is warranted when the deployment target differs from the training source: an adapted DINOv2 outperformed two independently tuned U-Nets on all eight out-of-distribution sets in DSC, IoU, sensitivity and HD95, whereas within the training distribution and at the full training set a well-configured U-Net matched it.
blocks.zh: 如果部署目标与培训来源不同,则有必要进行调整:在DSC、IoU、灵敏度和HD95中,经过调整的DINOv2在八套分配外的U-Net上都比两套独立调制的U-Net好,而在培训分配和全面培训中,则设置了一个配置良好的U-Net。

blocks.en: Little adaptation is needed: bias-only tuning captures most of the benefit, and LoRA at 2.7 per cent of the parameters equals or exceeds full fine-tuning in DSC on all five polyp sets.
blocks.zh: 不需要做什么调整:只偏偏调能捕捉到大部分好处,而LORA2.7%的参数等于或超过DSC中所有5个聚p集的全微调.

blocks.en: How much adaptation is needed is a property of the domain rather than of the method, varying eightfold in LoRA rank across domains and reproduced by a method with no rank parameter, so capacity must be selected on the target domain.
blocks.zh: 需要多少适应是域而不是方法的属性,在洛拉分级中,有八倍不同,是跨域的,用没有排名参数的方法复制,所以必须在目标域上选择能力.
